articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of the human-like two-armed jumping robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The jumping procedure of the human was captured with a high-speed video camera. The geometrical configurations and motion postures of the human during jumping were analyzed from the high-speed photographs. By biological observation and kinematic analysis, the human jump was divided into stance phase, flight phase and land phase. The role of arm motion to the performance of the human during jumping was investigated. The dynamic model of the jumping robot was established by the technology of virtual prototype. The displacement, velocity, acceleration and spring force of the robot during jumping were analyzed. The results would provide some theoretical and practical references for biomimetic design for improving the reasonable motion of the jumping robot. This work may provide the basic theory in developing human-like jumping robot in structural design. Besides, it provides an important reference to study the other bionic robots.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of microstructures evolution for three-high cross-rolling of hollow steels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the rigid-plastic finite element method (FEM), an investigation on three-high cross-rolling of hollow steels was carried out in this study. The numerical model coupled thermal, mechanical and microstructural phenomena, in which some empirical recrystallization mode were obtained using the Gleeble-3500 thermomechanical simulator. The distributions of different field-variables, including temperature, strain and grain size, were obtained by FEM simulation. After different mandrel diameters were calculated, the investigation obtained the effect of microstructures evolution and compared the grain size between no mandrel and different mandrel diameters.

articleTitle: Rapid prototyping of reentry vehicle navigation and guidance systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, rapid prototyping method is proposed and implemented for the development of reentry vehicle navigation and guidance systems. V-Cycle development approach based on rapid control prototyping is introduced to develop navigation and guidance systems efficiently. High-level modeling and simulation tools and integrated rapid prototyping systems such as RT-LAB used in the V-Cycle approach can greatly reduce the cycle and cost for the development of navigation and guidance systems compared with traditional development methods.

articleTitle: Application research of Web services in EAI based on Eclipse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Under Intranet or Internet environment, it becomes more and more important how to make application systems communicate and share data seamlessly, thus eliminates the huge information isolated island, realizes the information sharing and exchange. Web services is one of the best solution for enterprise application integration (EAI). In this paper, after analyzing the architecture and the protocols of Web services, a application integration system was designed and implemented using open source development and deployment platform Eclipse and its J2EE plug-in WTP. The research results can be further applied to e- commerce, manufacturing process control, geographic information systems, numerical computing and other fields.

articleTitle: A novel distance-assisted localization algorithm in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, calculation and management of node position is a subject which has a profound theoretical basis and wide range of application. Due to the randomness of sensor network nodes and the dynamic variability of network topology, lots of algorithms can not meet the requirements of positioning accuracy. For this reason, a DV-DScale localization algorithm is proposed in this paper based on distance-assisted and hop quantization. In the algorithm, cumulative distance value is no longer directly used for maximum likelihood estimation to localization, but as scale to amend the straight-line distance between nodes and estimate the position information of nodes. Because of the low resolution of hops, the traditional localization algorithm which is based on hop can only adapt to the isotropic dense networks. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm effectively ameliorate the positioning accuracy. Even in the case of random distribution of nodes, the algorithm can also get a higher positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and study of the high-precision stepping motor control system for intelligent sampling of liquid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the development of machinery and electronics toward digital and intelligent, the study of control system takes a very important role. The high-precision stepping motor control system for intelligent sampling of liquid achieves intelligent and high-precision sampling locations by the intelligent high-precision controlling of stepper motor. Stepper motor is the implementing agency that put an electrical pulse into the angular displacement. The high-precision stepper motor control system is based on the ARM S3C44B0, combined with a power supply, keyboard input, serial communications, stepper motor driver, photoelectric sensor positioning, host computer operating software and other modules. All these modules set up an intelligent and high-precision control system of stepper motor. The operator can complete intelligent control of stepper motor by the keyboard or the host computer operating software. High-precision stepper motor positioning can be achieved by photoelectric sensor positioning, avoiding accumulated error that is produce by losing step, which make the control system of stepping motor can work in the long-term operation of high-precision occasions.

articleTitle: (s,t]-fuzzy filters of BCK-algebras
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The definitions of (∈,∈∨q)-fuzzy filter and (β̄,ᾱ)-fuzzy filter, and four new (β̄,ᾱ)-fuzzy filters are acquired. As a generalization of fuzzy BCK-filter, (∈,∈∨q) -fuzzy filter and (∈,∈̄∨q) -fuzzy filter, we give the definition of (s,t]-fuzzy filter with thresholds. The relations between these fuzzy filters and their level filters are discussed, some proposed are studed, and their equivalent descriptions are given. How to deal with the homomorphic image and inverse image of (s,t]-fuzzy filters are investigated.

articleTitle: A new data mining method based on extenics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Extenics is a new discipline which is solve contradiction problem, the study of data mining is mining useful knowledge from the data. With the rapid development of information society, information, knowledge toward overload age, how to mining the useful and changes knowledge to propose the new topic for the data mining, the establishment of Extenics provides new ideas and methods for data mining and opened up the new research direction for the data mining, The use of combining extenics methods with data mining technology not only can access to static knowledge but can mining the changed knowledge, and through the example illustrating the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Testing method of camera dynamic response
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The dynamic response of cameras affects the image quality apparently, characterized by the image blurring, the distortion of geometrical size and gray of image, when shoot a dynamic scene. A particular experimental setup was designed upon the mechanism of cameras, the gray data containing the response information were extracted from the concerned pixels of the motion image, and then the dynamic response was modeled by processing the extracted gray data with Least-square algorithm. The result indicates that the dynamic response of cameras can be expressed as a first-order system, a model with agreeable accuracy due to the fitting error approximating to 0.2. The proposed method can be readily used for testing the dynamic response of cameras in general application, and the dynamic response can be applied to resolve some related problems in machine vision.

articleTitle: Leakage analysis and Its application in calculating a sinusoidal parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Spectrum leakage is frequently the most effective factor that leads to a considerable error in estimating signal parameters. In our work, an investigation is conducted that how DFT calculations distributed over the leakage spectrum of a sinusoid depends on the length of a windowed sinusoid. It is found that the leakage variation with a sinusoid length can be expressed by a sinc function, which connects DFT calculations with the amplitude, period of a single frequency signal and the length of the windowed sinusoid. Finally, an accurate approach is proposed that can theoretically immune to the leakage effect. The conclusions suggest a new expression for a sinusoid, disclose the leakage law and may lead to some potential applications in DSP.

articleTitle: Performance measurement of supply chain based on computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper introduced multi-objective fuzzy optimal decision theory into performance measurement of supply chain, and evaluated ordering policy with the performance measurement simulation model. It was shown that the best strategy could be identified and overall performance of supply chain optimal.

articleTitle: A posteriori error estimation of the finite element solutions for elliptic double obstacle problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A posteriori estimation of the finite element solutions for double obstacle problems is obtained. There has been a well-established theory and a large number of a posteriori error estimations for linear elliptic one-sided obstacle problems. We will show that the estimation for ∥ z - u<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</sub>∥<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> is also suited for double obstacle problems.

articleTitle: Coal mine water inrush data analysis research based on parallel coordinates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the use of parallel coordinates which is the most representative multi-dimensional visualization method, the coal mines water inrush data is visualized to do the cluster analysis and sensitive data analysis. The rule of coal mine water inrush is summarized.

articleTitle: The application of web communication tools in university library
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Today is network times, and the university library is the second classroom of college students, based on such environment, this article discusses the university library how to comply with the requirements of the times. Base on the existing foundation of hardware, innovative service model, and by using the network communication tools to strengthen the exchange of information, then enhance the services level of library.

articleTitle: Exploration and research of Service-oriented Architecture Model in the course of enterprise's network service registration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Nowadays Service-oriented Architecture Model and the Web Services Technology which serves it have become a development and research direction of solving service integration issues. This paper makes a number of exploration and research on the implementation of Service-oriented Architecture Model in the course of enterprise's network service registration.

articleTitle: PeerMonitor: A P2P-based architecture for video monitoring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With rapidly growing demand for real-time video monitoring, providing a robust large-scale video monitoring service is a both challenging and crucial task. This paper proposes a P2P-based video monitoring architecture called PeerMonitor which can implement large-scale network video monitoring application using a relatively small number of server. By fully taking different use interests in different monitoring scene into account, PeerMonitor provides a more efficient scene switch operation. The proposed architecture also decreases video delivering delay by improving Pure-Pull strategy and data-flow-based push-pull strategy between nodes in DONet. The simulation result demonstrates the efficiency of the proposal.

articleTitle: The use of current probes in S-parameter determination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents a technique to determine S-parameters with two current probes. One probe is used to inject current, the other measure current. The method uses the probes as a device described by scattering parameters. The tradional method to measure scattering parameters needs disconnect the device from system and connects it to VNA. In topological analysis, the method we propose only requires that the ports of the device under test present a wire extension. Based on topological definition, the technique are described assuming that the probes behave like ideal transformers. The paper has a experiment to compare two methods. The methods has an ideal result correspond to traditional method below 10MHz, from 10MHz to 100MHz the error is smaller than 10dB. It is discovered that the main reason of the error is the limit of the performance of probes. So the method can be used in electromagnetic effect analysis of pulse that raise time smaller than 1ns, for its main frequency is smaller than 100MHz.

articleTitle: An enhanced single-hop DHT lookup algorithm for structured P2P networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an enhanced single-hop peer-to-peer lookup algorithm. With the improvement on the messages dissemination, our algorithm achieves more flexible network loading distribution and pretty better time saving performance than other single-hop DHT algorithms. In the experimental results, we further show that our enhanced single-hop peer-to-peer lookup algorithm makes a reasonable maintenance consuming as a trade-off for the efficiency of lookup, and also gets fairer network loading balance in the system.

articleTitle: Cryptanalysis of a certificateless encryption scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Certificateless public key cryptography was introduced to address the heavy certificate management in traditional public key cryptography and the key escrow problem in identity-based public key cryptography. Two types of adversaries are considered in certificateless public key cryptography: Type I adversary (outsider) and Type II Adversary (honest-but-curious and/or malicious-but-passive key generation center). A secure certificateless encryption (CLE) scheme must be secure against both types of adversaries. In this paper, we illustrate a recently proposed threshold CLE scheme is insecure against Type I adversaries.

articleTitle: Improved genetic complex algorithm and its application in the formula optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to solve the problem of “premature convergence” and low efficiency during the later period of the evolution, an improved genetic algorithm was proposed. Based on this method, integrated with complex method, an improved genetic complex algorithm was established and used in the formula optimization. Take the formula optimization of ceramics body for example, we got the best percentage of formula, and made the results fully meet the goal formulation.

articleTitle: Enhance internet routing availability with multipath inter-domain routing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: As the fundamental of Internet architecture, inter-domain routing and its availability are the concern of the community. The de facto inter-domain routing protocol, BGP, selects and announces only single route for each destination prefix. That will lead to when router or link failure occurs, network experience unavailability, even if feasible path exists. To address this issue, some proposals speed up the routing protocol convergence to reduce the transient loss of reachability during route convergence. In this paper, we present the multipath inter-domain routing by revising the current BGP protocol. The basic ideas is to add the MULTIPATH capability option to BGP protocol for supporting the negotiation between BGP peers, and modify the routing decision process for permitting route announce candidate routes to its neighbor routers. Our proposal provides the backwards compatible with the traditional BGP systems. The benefits of the scheme are demonstrated using the realistic simulations.

articleTitle: Inversion algorithm of photon correlation spectroscopy by combining linear and nonlinear estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Double exponential algorithm of photon correlation spectroscopy (PCS) is realized by the nonlinear estimation, its inversion accuracy is affected by four initial parameters choice. According to linear relationship of the decay linewidth distribution coefficients and exponential terms of autocorrelation function (ACF), a new inversion algorithm combining linear and nonlinear estimation is proposed. By changing four parameters optimization problem into two parameters optimization problem in turns, new algorithm improves the inversion accuracy and reduces two initial parameters. By new and tradition algorithm, ACF of 200nm - 600nm bi-dispersed particles is respectively inversed. For noise-free ACF, inversion error of new algorithm is 0, which is at least better than tradition algorithm 2.01%. For inversion of noise ACF, compared with tradition algorithm, new algorithm can reduce inversion error by 0.93% ~ 6.43%. Therefore, new algorithm is superior to tradition algorithm in inversion accuracy and tolerance of noises.

articleTitle: A novel condenser fault diagnosis method based on KPCA and multiclass SVMs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A novel fault diagnosis method of condenser based on kernel principle component analysis (KPCA) and multi-class support vector machines (MSVMs) is proposed in this paper. KPCA is applied to MSVMs for feature extraction. It firstly maps data from the original input space into high dimensional feature space via nonlinear kernel function and then extract optimal feature vector as the inputs of MSVMs to solve condenser fault classification problems. A global optimizer, particle swarm optimizer (PSO), is employed to optimize the parameters of MSVMs to improve fault classification accuracy. The experimental results show that the proposed approach can effectively capture the nonlinear relationship among variables and improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design of signal preprocessing circuit in receiver of buried cable detector
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The scheme of multi-antenna array needs the system to have the ability of collection of multi-signal channels and can switch with requirement quickly. Also, it takes a high demand to the distinction of the circuit that the strong noise in complex environment will disturb the magnetic field easily. This article makes an optimal design to the signal preprocessing circuit, it takes resonance technology to improve the gather ability of special frequency, use difference amplifier to improve the common mode noise, and use band-pass filter to filter the noise. Gain control circuit is also used to adjust the signal level in order to make the signal to fit with the range of the A/D convertor.

articleTitle: Intelligent environment for CNC machine operator training
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The CNC machine tool is a complex system wherein machine operators play a key role in keeping machine productive and competitive. Traditional operator training consisted mainly of on-the-job training (OJT) which provides novice with the hands-on experience at high cost but it lacks the ability to provide real-time feedback and exposure to various scenarios in which to operate. This paper presents an intelligent environment composed by machining simulation and hypermedia components for CNC machine operator training. The aim of this training system is to provide operator of virtual machining scenario supported by expert system and web courses,to acquire knowledge and skills through efficient,safe,flexible and low-cost method.The cognitive analysis and performance measurement have certified this training system is effective and promising.

articleTitle: The design of an e-cash system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the rapid development of the computer and network and information technology, transaction based e-cash has instead the traditional check transaction. In recent years, the main concern is operation efficiency and safety aspect about e-cash system. This paper proposes a fair and efficient anonymous off-line electronic cash system based on the control technology of group signature and blind signature. Finally, from the safety analysis of the system and similar other systems, it has many security features about sthe anti-counterfeiting, anti-tracking anti-re-payments.

articleTitle: Research on the failure character in the shock signal based on the EEMD theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: On the basis of the research on the shock signal, the composition and frequency characteristic of the signal are proposed. Through the field test of the engine gearbox, the acceleration signal is achieved and conducted with spectrum analysis to obtain the natural frequency. A method of transient signal analysis based on the EEMD theory of order domain was presented, through the EEMD algorithm, the signal is decomposed and IMFs are achieved. By the analysis of the IMFs, the characteristic of the shock signal is obtained which can be the foundation for us to clearly research the signal and to analyze typical gear failure.

articleTitle: The construction study of water environment evaluation system on the basis of GIS and ANN
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This article constructs the integrated evaluation system on the basis of GIS secondary development. Through spatial expression ability of GIS, we make overall situation of water quality and variation tendency more clear to the administrators. For different years and monitoring sections, through the menu, we can easily obtain monitor water quality values from backstage supported database, and calculate the evaluation value through model in the model-base automatically, then come out to show directly at electronic map. All these can realize the integration of many functions: evaluation work of water quality, spatial analysis, automatic calculation, etc, greatly improve working efficiency of water quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Robust control of robot manipulators based on H∞ neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The trajectory tracking of a class of robot manipulators with disturbance and parameter uncertainties is considered. This paper proposes a adaptive neural-variable Structure control algorithm based on H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> theory. The controller that integrates neutral network with variable by way of smooth function. This integrated controller can reduce chattering of variable structure control input, overcome the deficiencies of local generalization neural networks and improve control precision and convergence speed. In addition, This controller is still able to ensure the system maintains good robustness and stability in the case of neural network disabled. the integrated controller is used to adaptive learn and compensate the unknown system, approach error as disturbance is eliminated by robust controller. Robust controller and compensator with robust adaptive laws are constructed based on stability of closed-loop system stability. The simulation results show the presented method is possesses great control accuracy and dynamic function.

articleTitle: The bit-pattern integral attack of reduced-round AC block cipher
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A new way to cryptanalysis the AC block cipher is presented in this document. The AC block cipher is based upon the bit-slice technology. By using the bit-pattern integral attack, a 2-round integral distinguisher can be get; then using this distinguisher can attack on 3-round of AC block cipher. It is shown that the full subkey of 3-round AC can be recovered with 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12.5</sup> chosen plaintexts and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">56</sup> partial decryptions. Therefore, 3-round AC is not immune to bit-pattern integral attack. Moreover, our attack has the lowest memory requirements compared to existing attack on AC.

articleTitle: Study Oil logistics demand prediction based on grey system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the development of economics the demand of oil logistics has also rapidly increased, grasping the variation of oil companies' logistics demand timely and accurately has a great significance on smooth operation of the national economy. This paper takes advantage of grey model of prediction quantitatively research on the logistics demand of oil companies, the examples show that the model of prediction has a higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of segmented adaptive filter
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Adaptive filter design attract more and more attention recently. Generally algorithm is relatively complicated and with long processing time. In certain cases, segmented filter could be introduced to simplify the complicated process and obtains the similar results. The Fourier transform and wavelet transform are direct or indirect developments of the method.

articleTitle: A behavior-based trust model in P2P
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: P2P networks, also known as peer to peer network , enabling network-based P2P nodes dynamic, anonymity, scalability, etc. The security of the network caused a severe challenge. This paper introduces the traditional PKI system to authenticate the credibility of the node s based on the further introduction of the behavioral characteristics of the nodes, according to the node transactions to classify the different behaviors, according to punish, to further improve the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Allied fuzzy c-means clustering using kernel methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Allied fuzzy c-means (AFCM) clustering is a hybrid fuzzy clustering algorithm based on the combination of fuzzy c-means (FCM) and new possibilistic c-means (NPCM). AFCM can deal with noisy data better than FCM and does not generate coincident clusters. With kernel methods AFCM is improved as its kernel learning machine model. This proposed algorithm is called kernel allied fuzzy c-means (KAFCM) clustering. KAFCM is suitable for classification of nonlinear separable patterns while AFCM deals with linear separable patterns well. KAFCM can nonlinearly map the input data into a high-dimensional feature space where the nonlinear pattern now appears linear and AFCM is performed. The better performance of our proposed algorithm is shown by performing experiments on artificial dataset and standard IRIS dataset.

articleTitle: Fabric dynamic simulation based on 3D motion estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The reality effect is an important factor for fabric dynamic simulation. This paper proposes an approach based on fabric 3D motion estimation to improve the reality effect of fabric dynamic simulation. Due to the very non-rigid motion of fabric and the ill-posed problem of 3D motion estimation, this paper establish a framework of Markov random field (MRF) with constraints. By incorporating the motion prior constraints into the MRF, the motion smoothness features between local fabric regions is reflected. By minimizing the energy function of the MRF, 3D motion estimation of the fabric is achieved. Then, the recovered 3D coordinates of fabric feature points are used to adjust simulation computing process based on the mass-spring model, and simulation results with good reality effect are obtained. Experimental results for fabric dynamic simulation demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Multi-parameter inverse analysis research based on Comsol Multiphysics and Matlab
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper constructs a parameter inverse analysis model for the diffusion analysis experiments of multi-ion transport model. It transforms multi-parameter inverse analysis problem into an optimization problem for nonlinear constrained planning. The optimization principle, the sequential quadratic programming method (SQP) for optimization and its implementation method in Matlab are introduced. With Comsol Multiphysics, multi-ion transport model is analyzed positively and is edited into the objective function (File .M) that can be directly utilized by Matlab. Then the fmincon function of the nonlinear optimization of Matlab to solve and analyze the problems. The proliferation tests of NaCl salt solution in the clay are under inverse analysis to obtain macro-transport parameters. The analysis shows that this method has fast convergence and high accuracy. This method is also beneficial to the similar optimization analysis of multi-parameter inverse analysis problems and complex nonlinear multi-field coupling problems.

articleTitle: Prediction of fiber diameter of spunbonding nonwovens by using neural network and multiple regression models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this article, the multiple regression model and neural network model are designed and used to predicting the fiber diameter of spunbonding nonwovens from the process parameters. The neural network has good approximation capability and fast convergence rate, and it can provide quantitative predictions of fiber diameter. The results show the ANN model can yield more accurate and stable predictions than the multiple regression model. The predicted and experimental values agree well, indicating that the neural network is an excellent method for predictors.

articleTitle: Knowledge representation of software faults based on open bug repository
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Bug repository of open source software contains a mass of historical data about behaviors of software failure and life-cycle of bug process. By surveying and analyzing three kinds of open source software as Apache, Eclipse, and Firefox, a practical knowledge representation of software faults is properly depicted in this paper. An algorithm is further given to transfer a software bug report to a software fault case, greatly reducing cost and time for constructing case base of software fault from scratch. All of these results have significant advantages for developing an intelligent fault diagnosis system based on case-reasoning.

articleTitle: Time-stamped multivariable generalized predictive control of network control systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The key point of the network control systems is that conventional generalized predictive control algorithm cannot deal with random delays, packet losses and vacant sampling. In this paper, the time-stamped multivariable generalized predictive control (TSMGPC) was proposed to deal with this problem. The TSMGPC used time-stamped to calculate the real delay, and the least mean square (LMS) algorithm to estimate the induced delay. In order to reduce the transmission times between the controller and the actuator, a threshold that was set in advance would be used to decide whether the control information were sent to the actuator or not. The simulation results show that the TSMGPC can trace the desired output precisely.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic optimization of NC grinder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: To improve machining precision of the numerical control (NC) machine tool, the method of dynamic optimization design was applied. The accurate finite element model (FEM) of the original NC grinder was established based on the results via compared actually dynamic test with theoretical analysis, The sensitivity analysis was applied to optimize the layout and parameters of the strengthening ribs of parts. The technique of modal frequency separation was applied to keep frequency separation of the main parts one another,and the structure of the main parts was optimized. The result of dynamic optimization design shows that the first order natural frequency of the new grinder raises 17% compared with the original one, while the relative vibration displacement between head of the grinder and the work piece reduces 10% correspondingly. The grinding chatter marks are eliminated and the machining accuracy is greatly raised.

articleTitle: Application of gray correlation analysis in confirming the controlling factors of mining subsidence in TongChuan mining area of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: On the basis of the observed data of 16 the ground surface movement surveying stations and field observations, and some conditions on geology and mining were took into consideration fully, there were 10 controlling factors were designed. Then these 10 controlling factors were ordered on their contribution to mining subsidence by gray incidence analysis. At last the main controlling factors of mining subsidence in TongChuan mining area of China are perturbation coefficient, integrated hardness of overburden strata, thickness of surface soil, width of working face and thick of coal seam. When all the factors mentioned above are considered, the mining subsidence forecast precision will be improved effetely.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of semantic programming language graphical edit tool
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: SPL is a Semantic Web services oriented programming language which is based on ontology and XML. At present, it is still devoid of a platform to edit SPL program, this paper provides a tool called SPL Editor for the development of semantic program on the base of SPL language standard, and shows how to use the tool through a travel booking case. It will be quick and convenient for the programmer to complete the development of semantic program in the support of this tool.

articleTitle: Novel solar heat pump Multifunctional Machine electronic expansion valve PID control simulation and implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper describes the princle of a novel solar heat Multifunctional Machine (SAHPM). Digital PID control and its improvement are discussed in details. The PID control scheme is proposed based on the improved type II digital PID control theory. In addition, the initialization of related parameters, PID simulink model and optimized simulation curve are demonstrated in the paper.

Author Keywords: Solar heat pump electronic expansion valve PID

articleTitle: Novel intelligent NIPS model based on Multiple Mobile Agents and data mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents a Novel intelligent Intrusion Prevention System (NIPS) model based on mobile agent and data mining. By analyzing the features of intrusion prevention system, mobile agent and data mining, the proposed model has the advantages of real-time acquisition and abnormal information recognition of data mining, the model can solve the internet security false negative and false positive problems effectively, so it can enhance the inspection and recognition decision-making and the whole intelligent defense ability of the NIPS.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation to solve protruding issue on axle box rod rubber joint of 2B0 heavy haul locomotive
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper aimed at protruding issue on axle box linkage of 2B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> heavy haul locomotive, analyzed why this problem happened. According to SIMPACK dynamic software, built the dynamic model of 2B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> locomotive which considered the actual structure of axle box, calculated all rod's force condition on curve passing, then validated its Structural strength by using finite element way. The results showed that: When locomotive curving, maze-shaped rubber joint lateral force and deflection torque are far larger than that of cylindrical tube rubber joint. This means continuing huge stress acting on rubber joint, in the end, protruding happened on the edge of axle box rod rubber joint.

articleTitle: On building computer-based college English teaching quality assurance system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With further promotion of computer-based college English teaching mode, it is necessary to build a quality assurance system to promote the standardized design of college English teaching system and improve teaching quality. The construction of a scientific, reasonable and feasible college English teaching quality assurance system should follow the principles of science, comprehensiveness, process and development. Teaching management system, teaching security system, teaching process monitoring system and teaching quality evaluation system constitute computer-based college English teaching quality assurance system, a complicated and systematic project demanding continuous development and improvement on the basis of in-depth study and practice.

articleTitle: Modeling method of embedded real-time software based on UML and XYZ/E
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of embedded real-time system, the function of modeling is more important in the embedded real-time software development. UML has actually become the industry standard in the field of embedded real-time software modeling at present. However, the lack of precise semantics makes it difficult to analyze and validate models it describes. The executable linear temporal logic language XYZ/E can represent both static semantics and dynamic semantics. Based on these, a practical scheme combining UML and XYZ/E to develop embedded real-time software is proposed, which also provides a formal basis for analysis and validation of the model.

articleTitle: Fuzzy multivariable controller for collecting main pressure control by fuzzy feed-forward decoupling method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, an novel fuzzy controller is proposed to obtain a collecting main pressure stable for the collecting main pressure control in coke oven with unbalanced loadings, multi-parameters, nonlinearities, and disturbances. The fuzzy control system consists of several fuzzy pressure controllers for collecting pipeline pressures and blast fans speed, and a feed-forward decoupling control unit for the disturbance in the collecting main pressure control system. In the fuzzy controller, several fuzzy pressure controllers are regulated by close-loop control loop. Each fuzzy pressure controller uses feedback control to minimize the pressure error in the loop, and the decoupling controller uses fuzzy technique to compensate the interactions in the collecting main pressure control system. The decoupling controller predicts the disturbance amongst the control parameters, and modifies the compensation of the fuzzy pressure controllers. The experimental results show that the proposed fuzzy controller can effectively achieve the objective of collecting main pressure stable in the requirement range with high load.

articleTitle: The scattered point cloud denoising method based on surfacelet transform of 3D context
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper proposed a fast denoising disposal method for scattered point cloud. The best approximation plane is determined by application of least-squares method and a new three-dimensional coordinates is established by the law vector of the plane as Z-axis, Scattered point will be coordinate transformation to new coordinate system; to conversion of scattered data process surfacelet transform and use improved 3D context model to estimate coefficient threshold of transformed different scales. According to threshold, the coefficient is filtered for denoising aim and the scattered point cloud convergence for a stable 3-D digital model. The experiment results show that noise is significant suppressed after denoising fairing data. Compared with other methods, processed data is more fairing and this method better retains detail features of the scattered points of 3D shape. This method makes full use of the relationship of 3D point cloud and provides the necessary preconditions for further three-dimensional reconstruction work.

articleTitle: Data exchange method and platform design of heterogeneous databases
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Data exchange of the heterogeneous database can perfectly accomplish transmission and exchange of the heterogeneous data and satisfy the requests for data exchange and sharing. Data exchange technology is studied. Data exchange platform based on JAVA and XML is designed by using XML (eXtensible Markup Language) file as intermediate medium of data exchange and on the basis of the relevant operation of handling XML file with VTD-XML (Virtual Token Descriptor for XML), the new non-extraction XML analytical technology. The system structure and whole flow of the platform is introduced in detail. Much importance has been attached to describing the inter-conversion between relational schema of database and XML Schema and the realization of data extraction from relational database and XML data. The testing case indicates that the heterogeneity among heterogeneous data can be well solved to realize the data exchange among heterogeneous relational databases. The system platform is of scientific design and the selected implementing technology is reasonable.

articleTitle: Link intensity prediction of online dating networks based on weighted information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The main task of the existing link prediction is to predict link existence. However, this paper proposes a new method aiming at the online dating networks, which using weighted transactional information to predict link intensity. Three different supervised learning methods are used in detail, comparing the importance of attribute features, topological features, transactional features and global features based on users' profile information, as well as the influence of four different network graphs to the model performance. The experiment on Xiaonei dataset shows that the method used in this paper can be used to predict link intensity accurately, also illustrates that the global features have the greatest impact on the performance of model .

articleTitle: Parameter estimation algorithm for coherently distributed source
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A low-complexity estimation method is presented to estimate the parameter of coherently distributed source. The central direction of arrival (DOA) is estimated by proposed second-order statistics based on Schur-Hadamard product steering vector, and then angular spread are given by beamforming method. The method is a low-complex estimator that does not need a joint search in two-dimensional parameter space. And angular spread is included in the constraint, so it owns more robustness in estimating angular spread. The simulation results prove the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Optimal waveform design under energy constraint
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the development of modern technology, waveforms should be synthesized efficiently in different environment. In this paper, we propose a new waveform design method which converts the problem of waveform design into the problem of optimization. Then we use steepest descent method to solve the problem under energy constraint. The simulation results demonstrate the validity of our algorithm. Finally, the whole paper is summarized.

articleTitle: User number detection based on rotational invariance techniques in OFDMA system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A robust user number detection method for OFDMA uplink is proposed in this paper. The presented method makes using of the special periodicity of the received signals in one OFDMA block to form a new matrix. Via the rotational invariance techniques, the number of involved users can be estimated. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of RF non-magnetic heat meter featuring low power consumption basing on flooding route
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper designs a low-power heat meter which is applied in wireless meter reading network of the high-rise buildings. The heat meter functions as a network node, so the design of the heat meter explores the embedded design method. We choose low-power microcontroller MSP430FW427 to be the controller, and its integrated SCAN IF module to test the flow. The combination of methods of the look-up table and linear interpolation is adopted to detect the temperature of the supply and return water. An improved flooding routing protocol is proposed to fulfill the wireless meter reading for high-rise buildings. The temperature, flow rate, and analog RF test results are acquired after the check on the heat meter. Tests show that the heat meter has the advantages of accurate measurement, stable run, fast meter reading, and convenient maintenance, etc., and it has reached national second level

articleTitle: A framework for defining XML views
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: XML has become the de facto standard for representing and interchanging data in web-based applications. And XML view has been widely applied. In relational database, the views are often defined by a query statement, though there may be GUI tools as aids. However, the users usually desire a conceptual modeling tool to help them define views and communicate with each other. Richer semantics are also expected when users tackle view related issues, such as view updates. In this paper, we present a framework for defining XML views, which includes three levels: conceptual level, logical level and physical level. Conceptual level is described by some conceptual model, e.g. EER or UML. Logical level is captured by some XML schema language and physical level is the XML views data. In particular, we show what semantics should be captured and how to represent them.

articleTitle: Distributed on-line water quality monitoring system based on embedded Web&CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: By combining CAN bus, Embedded web and Ethernet, a kind of distributed on-line Water Quality Monitoring System based on CAN and Embedded web is presented. The system's hardware and software architecture are analyzed,the measuring principle based on spectrophotometry is used in the system,the C8051F040 as a microprocessor is used in water quality monitoring node,the water quality signal is obtained by the optical sensors,the hardware platform of embedded web server based on S3C2410X is constructed,with CAN bus as bottom interface, Subnode use CAN subnet,and also send field data through Internet instantly. The system can achieve the real-time remote water quality monitoring and alarm with CGI technology, and have a good price-performance ratio.

articleTitle: Research on the temperature field of a dry gas seal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: For further research on temperature field and thermal strain of dry gas seal, numerical simulation is carried out. It is discovered, the temperature of rotating ring declined gradually from inside to outside, maximum temperature (85.45°C) appeared at the inner side of the face, minimum temperature (72.18°C) appeared at the left outside of the ring, with a temperature difference of 13.27°C. The face temperature curve is similar to a parabola; the position maximum temperature appeared is 8.7mm distant from inside, outside of the face has the minimum temperature, with a temperature difference of 3.25°C. By using the material with higher thermal conductivity and controlling the position of face groove, the thermal strain is reduced, gas dynamical reaction and film stiffness is enhanced, thereby, higher stability will be gained.

articleTitle: Quick measurement of truck cab coverings with ATOS scanner
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper introduces the measuring procedure by ATOS by measuring the cab contour of a truck. ATOS raster scanner is one of the most advanced three-dimensional scanning systems. It pieces together the many scanned views through reference points. Fast measuring of the cab contour is a key link in the design of a cab. It can convert a solid model into a digital one. ATOS raster scanner can achieve the point cloud data of the cab covering curve rapidly, and process it directly. In actual application, it effectively meets the technique need of bringing forth new products rapidly.

articleTitle: Application research of semantic ontology technology in content-based image retrieval
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications

articleTitle: The design of communication platform for teaching by virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Virtual instrument software LabVIEW is a graphical programming language characterized by easy to be read and understood. So it is suitable for teaching difficult theoretical kinds of courses. Communication theory is a theoretical course and its many concepts are abstract. To solve the problems of hard to learn and teach, a teaching platform for communication theory was built by virtual instrument development tools-LabVIEW in this paper. The platform covers the main contents of the course and demonstrates communication systems animatedly. The novel platform provides a new way for teaching and more resources for campus web. As a example of the communication platform, MSK((Minimum Shift Keying)) modulation and demodulation simulation system is designed and demonstrated.

articleTitle: The output of the dynamic charts in the high arch dams' construction simulation systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The output of the dynamic charts is an important part of high arch dams' construction simulation systems which provides an available tool for the construction management of high arch dams. Combining with the construction simulation system of Xiluodu arch dam, this paper analyses the method of using chart control to dynamically generate the relation curve chart of the dam concrete pouring amount and the efficiency chart of cable machines, which based on ActiveX Data Objects linking access 2007 database. The simulation results can be shown more directly and beautifully. Also the statistics work-load is simplified and the construction organization management of high arch dams is improved.

articleTitle: Hierarchy and grey analysis of the Synthetical Evaluation Index System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents three criteria, food quantity safety, food quality safety and sustainability of food safety, which organizing the Synthetical Evaluation Index System of Food Security. The combination analytic hierarchy process with the grey system theory establishes a scientific and perfect calculation model of food evaluation indicators security systems. The model is feasible through validation, and is worth promoting.

articleTitle: A wireless sensor networks localization algorithm based on optimal dividing circle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Location awareness becomes an essential capability of sensor nodes. In this paper, a novel range-free localization algorithm is proposed based on dividing circle, whose radius is equal to node communication range. By searching a certain area, the optimal dividing circle can be selected. The center of the optimal dividing circle is regarded as the position of the target node. The results of simulation show that our algorithm has increased the localization accuracy significantly, especially for the nodes at the edge of the network.

articleTitle: The application of RBF network based on the principle of immune in the condenser's fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: For the specific problems which is determined by the Center value and the width of the RBF neural network function, a new network training method is proposed. It is based on the immune theory and combines immune genetic algorithm with RBF neural network. And it is applied to realize the failure diagnosis of condenser. The result of verification shows that the proposed method can improve the accuracy and the speed of failure diagnosis effectively and has certain application value in engineering.

articleTitle: Redundancy control for reliability-lifetime tradeoff in energy harvesting wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Energy harvesting wireless sensor networks (EHWSN) are characterized by multihop wireless lossy links and resource constrained nodes that are able to harvest small amount of energy from ambient sources such as light, heat or vibration. For TDMA MAC protocols in EHWSN, redundancy and retransmission are two important methods to provide the high end-to-end data reliability. However, reliable transmissions will lead extra energy consumption. In this paper, for the TDMA MAC protocol, we propose a Reliability-Lifetime Tradeoff Framework (RLTF) for EHWSN to optimize the redundancy transmission number for each link. For the redundancy TDMA MAC, we formulate the RLTF as convex programming. By the gradient projection method, we develop a fully distributed algorithm to solve the convex programming.

articleTitle: Simulating the temporal and spatial heterogeneity of evapotranspiration among the different watersheds
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A modified Priestley-Taylor model is established to simulate the temporal and spatial variation of regional Evapotranspiration. In which, the solar radiation was improved by accounting for the variations in slope and azimuth of land surface and terrain. Result is shown that modified Presity-Taylor could well express the spatial heterogeneity of the potential evapotranspiration using remotely sensed vegetation index and temperature. The evapotranspiration of the upstream Minjiang River (UTM) was 406.88mm in 2005, while Shouxi watershed and Zagunao upside watershed were 471mm and 374mm, respectively. In addition, mixed forest and conifer forest have a higher evapotranspiration than that from other vegetation types all the year.

articleTitle: Parameterized plant builder for forest growth simulation and forest real-time rendering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Dynamic rendering large scale forest is still difficult, since it needs to create, maintain, grow and destruct tens of thousands of plant objects at runtime. This paper deals with this difficulty and presents a scene graph based scheme that allows us to model plants according to their growth stages, organ structures, and level of detail (LOD) requirements. To efficiently manipulate plant objects at runtime, plant growth data are stored in extensible markup language (XML) file, and a parameterized plant builder is developed to load proper plant model into memory and transform it to target appearance with given parameters. In order to decrease the memory consumption, all plant objects in memory are created and managed by plant builder in a centralized way so that plant objects can share textures, drawing states and other resources. By discretizing parameters that is used to create or grow plant objects, plant builder decreases the number of plant objects that really need to create in memory, and accelerates the plant creation and growth speed.

articleTitle: Complex-valued neural polynomial adaptive equalizer for digital satellite channels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: An adaptive equalizer using a complex-valued neural polynomial structure (CNPAE) is proposed for digital satellite channels in this paper. Since CNPAE consists of a single layer neural network and nonlinear processor, its structure is very simple. Moreover, it has fewer parameters than traditional methods (Multilayer neural networks, recurrent neural networks, Volterra filter and etc.). To evaluate the performance of the CNPAE, it is applied to solve nonlinear equalization problem of a digital satellite communication channel for M-PSK, which has server nonlinearity with memory. Simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the CNPAE.

articleTitle: Research on the spread feeling system of vein wave
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The diagnosis by feeling the pulse is the most difficult to examine in the doctor of traditional Chinese medicine diagnose including takes a look at, hears, asks and cuts.This research will pass the method introducing one kind of new diagnosis by feeling the pulse, It is the instrument making use of computer heart pulse to measure blood pressure, And, analysis the wave carrying out pulse with the doctor of traditional Chinese medicine pulse wave biography feel system that our school studies. This research will help practitioners simply and objectively analysis patients with traditional Chinese medicine.

Author Keywords: The system of pulse wave biography feeling

articleTitle: Listed logistics company performance prediction by BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to forecast the performance of listed logistics company scientifically, and by using of adventage of BP neural network with self-organizing, self-learning, anti-interference, etc., a performance prediction model of listed logistics company was constructed with BP neural network. Then the step of the model was introduced in detail and BP algorithm was designed. Moreover, an example was studied with twenty-three listed logistics company's data in 2007. The examples show that the prediction results are basically consistent with the actual situation, and the comprehensive evaluation of the weight basically reflects the effect on performance of listed logistics company.

articleTitle: Research on pests and diseases expert system of urban forest based on agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: this paper applies the agent technology into the forestry pests and diseases expert system. Firstly, it introduces the agent technology and the expert system, and then a new design method is proposed, which unifies the domain expert's experience of pest diagnosis, disease diagnosis, pests forecasting and the achievement of prevention and control technique. Beside those, the pest forecasting and diagnosis mathematical model, vector apace model and TF-IDF algorithm are also constructed, at last these methods are take into application. Its application carries on the real-time predict, diagnosis and the prevention to the urban forest common pests and disease.

articleTitle: The application of MAS and C–W algorithm in purchase logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: An attempt was made to apply C-W algorithm,which is usually used in routed optimization in the domain of distribution,to purchase logistics. In view of the characteristic of transported products in the purchase logistics of assembly enterprises,the task was divided into initial tasks and unexpected tasks. The former adopted C-W algorithm that vehicle capacity, volume and arriving time as three constraints were inserted,the latter used autonomous vehicles competitive bidding independently,which could obtain the optimal solution and solve unexpected tasks timely and intellectually. Then an example was given to confirm the serviceability of C-W algorithm in distributing the initial tasks and autonomous vehicles competitive bidding independently and a good result was obtained.

articleTitle: A SVM-based method for abnormity detection of log curves
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Rapid and accurate abnormity detection of log curves is critical in the quality control for logging industry. Traditional methods based on manual detection have been proven to be ineffective and unreliable. A machine learning method based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) is proposed in this paper to address this problem. The SVM classifiers are established according to the suspicious sections selected from log curves and the detected results given by experts. A genetic algorithm (GA) is introduced for optimization of parameters. With GA and SVM fusions, the optimal models for classifiers are determined to detect abnormity sections. Experimental results of China XiangJiang Oilfield show that an accuracy of 95% is achieved for suspicious straight sections and 96% is achieved for suspicious bouncing sections, which has proven the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of e-government web site
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, from the evaluation theory and methods of e-government web site start drawing on various government web sites at home and abroad evaluation index system and assessment methods, combined with China's actual situation of e-government web site, using analytic hierarchy approach process to establish e-government web site evaluation index system. To guide the construction of the current e-government web site development.

articleTitle: An integrated optimization for hypersonic inlet design based on PYTHON
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, an integrated optimization program, based on PYTHON script programming language, has been developed by integrating CFD software and optimization package for shape optimization of high speed flight vehicles. The program comprises four functions connected with PYTHON scripts: geometry module, flow grid generator, flow solver, and optimizer, and the data of each part can be exchanged and updated automatically until the iterative study is completed. The paper takes two-dimensional hypersonic inlet with planar lip as an example for design and analysis. The numerical results show that the boundary-layer separation caused by shock boundary-layer interaction in the shoulder of inlet is reduced significantly and the total pressure recovery coefficient of the inlet is greatly improved against the model before optimized. With the increase in computer performance, the integrated optimization coupling with CFD technology will be the trend for vehicle design with aerodynamics in the future.

articleTitle: Modeling and adaptive technology of software engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This article describes some commonly used software engineering modeling and adaptive technology. From different angles and software life-cycle stage of the software can have a profound impact on improving flexibility, Including Rational Rose Demeter method, configuration management, system components and software reuse.

articleTitle: Process of complex group decision-making and its structural model of interactions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the analysis of complexity of decision-making process and the description of components of group decision-making process, this paper mainly discusses the decision loop and decision flow in the process interactions of complex decision-making, and proposes a general model of decision-making process and a structural model of process interactions of group decision-making, and makes a study of them.

articleTitle: Fisheye lens camera system calibration and localization error analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The paper presents a novel calibration method for fisheye lens. Five parameters, which fully reflect characters of fisheye lens, are proposed. Linear displacement platform is used to acquire precise sliding displacement between the target image and fisheye lens. Laser calibration method is designed to obtain the precise value of optical center. A convenient method, which is used to calculate the virtual focus of the fisheye lens, is proposed. To verify the result, indoor environment is built up to measure the localization error of omni-directional robot. Image including landmarks is acquired by fisheye lens and delivered to DSP (Digital Signal Processor) to futher process. Error analysis to localization of omni-directional robot is showed in the conclusion.

articleTitle: A self-adaptive DVS scheduling algorithm for multi-core systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Dynamic Voltage Scaling (DVS) is widely supported in modern general purpose systems, like desktops. Interval-based DVS algorithms have been used in some operating systems (OSs), like Linux. But their load prediction models can't fit various needs of users so well, since most of them employ one prediction method only. In this paper, a self-adaptive algorithm called SADVS is presented. It selects the best algorithm according to the prediction accuracy of historical records, and the selector will be used to adjust the CPU speed in the following interval. SADVS behaves well in both simulations and actual implementation. For actual implementation, we find that SADVS reduces energy consumption 0.02%~0.4% without time extension compared to results of ondemand policy in Linux kernel.

articleTitle: The optimization algorithm for attribute reduction based on Skowron discernibility matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The attribute reduction algorithm based on Skowron discernibility matrix is paid more attention, because of its intuition and understandability, however it only applies to compatible decision tables. In this paper, first, we analyze the cause of the error in solving attribute reduction of incompatible decision tables and then an improved discernibility matrix algorithm of attribute reduction based on consistency degree is given, finally, the validity of the algorithm is verified by our instance analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the delay jitter performance of SpaceWire network for space applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: SpaceWire is an advanced on-board high-rate serial bus standard. However, the research on the transmission delay characteristic of SpaceWire network is not comprehensive and thorough. This article aims at calculating the transmission delay jitter of network and discusses an effective calculation method by means of modeling the transmission process of SpaceWire network. This article also analyzes various factors that influence the data stream delay characteristics of SpaceWire network in practical space applications under a typical topology structure. The analyzing method and conclusions discussed in this article provide the theory and guidance for the design of the SpaceWire network with low delay jitter.

articleTitle: The application research of single sign out model based on CAS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In the single sign-on decency bring benefits to the enterprise application integration at the same time, with out a single sign out is even more important. This paper studied the CAS single sign out of the model presented, based on an improved model of single-point log off and greatly improve the flexibility of single-point log off, availability, and security.

articleTitle: Feature extraction based on ISIFT algorithm for image retrieval
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we proposed the ISIFT algorithm, in the normalized scale space, we generate 64-dimensional (4×4×4) feature vectors in order to reduce dimension, and improve matching accuracy by bidirectional matching, then based on these characteristic points we build index using BBF algorithm to find the nearest neighbour, and complete image retrieval finally. Image retrieval based on text, color, texture and other features often faced with the false retrieval caused by rotation, scaling and stretch changes, this study can not only avoid the false retrieval, but also applies in the image retrieval from observation target or scene in different perspectives.

articleTitle: The Simulation on attack and defense in OPNET environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to prove the function of firewall on defending the DOS nuke attack, the procedure and attribute of the Dos nuke attack was studied and analyzed. On the base of these, the attack and defence model of the Dos nuke attack was designed in the OPNET simulation environment. It simulated the network packet volume during before and after the attack on a victim host computer, and simulated the greatly reduction of the network packet volume on the victim host computer after adding a firewall between the computer and a packet generator. The security function of the firewall model is proved effectively from the point of simulation. It has some reference value to proving defence ability on firewall in simulation environment.

articleTitle: Application of graphic minimal covering algorithm in the distribution of surveillance cameras in small and medium-sized city road networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Surveillance camera, as an important component of intelligent transportation system, has had a big development in China. The study adopted the algorithm of graphic minimal covering to figure out economical and reasonable locations for surveillance cameras distribution in small and medium-sized city road networks. The minimal covering algorithm was further applied in a case study of an urban industrial park in which the optimal distribution of the cameras was finally found. The application of the algorithm lays a theoretical foundation for a well-designed distribution of surveillance cameras in small-medium city road networks. It is proved to be practical and useful.

articleTitle: Automatic positive sentiment word extraction for Chinese text classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Sentiment analysis aims to predict sentiment tendency automatically. Traditional methods tackling this problem are mostly based on supervised learning,but it is time-consuming and uneasy to extendable. In this paper,we provide a novel method of sentiment analysis based on un-supervised learning together with some language rules. It is no necessary to have a positive sentiment dictionary beforehand as we can build it automatically during processing the comments. By this positive sentiment dictionary,it provides an efficient way to classify the product reviews. The methodology presented is easy to extend due to its un-domain-dependency. As we can see,the experiment result obtained shows its promising application.

articleTitle: A novel forwarding algorithm over multipath network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this work, a novel data forwarding algorithm based on prediction method and optimization theory is proposed for improving the quality of service (QoS) in real-time applications over the wire network. The proposed prediction method is based on the time-series models of observed trends over all available network paths at each predetermined time. This predictive information is then used as an input for the forwarding decision. The forwarding algorithm is meant to minimize the packet loss rate by adjusting the forwarding rate of packets over each path for next prediction period by the PSO (particle swarm optimization). A number of experiments are performed. The proposed algorithm makes the most promising data forwarding method with an effective network performance, even under unfavorable scenarios.

articleTitle: An improved lossless image compression algorithm LOCO-R
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents a state-of-the-art implementation of lossless image compression algorithm LOCO-R, which is based on the LOCO-I (low complexity lossless compression for images) algorithm developed by weinberger, Seroussi and Sapiro, with modifications and betterment, the algorithm reduces obviously the implementation complexity. Experiments illustrate that this algorithm is better than Rice Compression typically by around 15 percent.

articleTitle: Research on indoor position algorithm based on image sequence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: People's demand for location information increase sharply, and people begin the research on the technology of vision location. In order to achieve of the result of exact and quick positioning, describe indoor position algorithm on block match of image sequence. First,initialize the image sequence, and then define search area, compute the MAD, return the coordinates of image, transform the coordinates, at last, get the change of two images. Experimental results show that the mobile track by algorithm can represent the actual path approximately.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of three-dimensional woven fabric
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In view of the defect and shortage in computer simulation of woven fabric, a three-dimensional woven fabric simulation algorithm and program are realized. Analyze the hierarchical structure of three-dimensional woven fabric, then design the algorithm of yarn interlacing model and trajectory calculation and yarn data storage structure in three-dimensional coordinate system. The warp and weft yarns are composed by several spatial arcs and straight lines connecting with each other expressed with the parameter equation. The simulation is achieved by a series of three-dimensional spherical model drawn by OpenGL library functions and Visual C++ along the calculated coordinate values. This modeling and simulation method, without blanking, can be more realistic to show the effect of three-dimensional woven fabric yarns interlaced with each other in three-dimensional space. Designers can preview the effect of finished product before weaving, so as to facilitate material development officer for analysis and design.

articleTitle: The research on dissemination algorithm based on neural network wireless network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks is a new technology that set MEMS, SOC and Wireless Communication Technology as a whole, which appears in recent years, It constitutes by Numerous Sensor node of Information Awareness Function, Information processing Function and Information Transfer Function.
