abstract: Immune algorithm is a kind of optimization algorithm, which has been used to solve combinatorial optimization problems. However, the theory research findings of immune algorithm is very little. We use the immune operator to improve the general immune algorithm; then, by probability theory, we know that population sequences converge to the global optimal solution in probability 1.

articleTitle: The risk assessment on BT financing model based on fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In view of the complexity of its operation process and the relationship between the parties involved, the success of BT project which is a new type of public project investment and financing method, to some extent, depends on reasonable risk-sharing. By analyzing the operation process and contractual relationship between parties involved, in this paper, we tried to establish a risk evaluation system based on fuzzy theory. In the end of this paper, a case study was given to demonstrate the application of the risk evaluation system in the hope to make some constructive suggestions for the further development of BT financing model.

articleTitle: Loop inspecting system of cab signalling based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The function of most cab signalling systems is rather simple through it is vital; no self-test and closed-loop inspecting and control is performed. To set out the requirements of a cab signalling system to ensure that where the driver's movement authority is indicated by cab display, the driver receives adequate and timely information regarding the movement authority and its limits. In this paper, a new kind of loop inspecting system of cab signalling is proposed based on the state-of-art virtual instrument technique. The system configuration and the operation procedure are introduced in detail, as well as the design principle of both hardware and software.

articleTitle: The study on evaluation of e-banking web sites from the viewpoint of customers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Nowadays electronic banking services are widely provided all over the world, but the adoption of such services has been slower than anticipated especially in developing countries. This paper reviewed the main factors that potential users may consider when evaluating an e-commerce web site and summarized these factors into three categories: security, easy of use and transaction cost. Moreover, the paper applies fuzzy set, entropy theory and gray relational analysis in combination to evaluate the performance of e-banking web sites. In addition, a numerical case is illustrated to test the model. The results show that the potential consumers' attention toward security, transaction cost and understandability are the main factors which have significant effect on their decisions making. Finally, several suggestion and future research are discussed.

articleTitle: Study of the fuzzy PID controlled super-capacitor auxiliary power system of the electrical vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A way to use super-capacitor as energy storage element to achieve regenerative braking energy recovery is presented, and the average model for the control circuit of the super-capacitor regenerative braking system is established based on fully analysis of the dynamic model of DC/DC full-bridge converter. The self-tuning fuzzy PID controller with the super-capacitor in charging/discharging states is designed according to the non-linear characteristics of the DC/DC converter. The simulation test shows that the self-tuning fuzzy PID controlled super-capacitor regenerative braking system is more effective than the gain PID control in increasing the driving current of the electric vehicle, improving its starting and accelerating performance, extending its driving range, particularly in improving its performance in responsive time and robustness.

articleTitle: FEM simulation of quenching residual stress for the plane strain problems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The temperature variation, phase transformation and phase-transformation plasticity are the main factors of inducing the initial strain in the quenching. In order to understand their effect on the residual stress of quenched part, a plane strain component is regarded as the study objective, and its FEM model is built. The effects of the initial strains on the quenching residual stresses are simulated using the self-developed FEM software. The stress components variation curves, the boundary displacements and the distortion of quenched part are given. The research results show that, the temperature reduction results in the uniform volume shrinkage of part, the phase transformation results in the uniform volume expansion of part, but the phase-transformation plasticity results in the unhomogeneous distortion of part.

articleTitle: Analysis of reference normal values of diadochokinetic rate and U.S. China comparison
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, based on Motor Speech Profile and combined with the normative data of DDK parameters in American adults, we tested 11 parameters of DDK, such as Average DDK Period, Average DDK Rate, Standard Deviation of DDK Period, Coeff.of Variation of DDK Period, Perturbation of DDK Period, Average DDK Peak Intensity and so on. According to our researches on the characteristics of normal motor speech in our college students and the differences of the norm values between Chinese and Americans, we verified the conclusion abroad that there is no relativity between genders and DDK parameters and found out the significant differences between Chinese and Americans. This provides foundation for formulating the normative data of diadochokinetic parameters suitable to Chinese language.

articleTitle: A culture-based study on information density of e-commerce websites
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This study investigates cultural effects on computer performance of users to e-commerce websites with different information density, and ways to design appropriate interfaces to accommodate cultural effects in order to enhance computer performance for Chinese users. There are many differences in page layout and information density of Chinese and Western e-commerce websites. An experiment was conducted to examine the usability and reliability of the selected Chinese and Western e-commerce websites. Thirty Chinese participants in China participated in this study. Information search tasks with different information density websites were designed to study selected websites' usability. And questionnaires were used to research their reliability. Results indicate that, for Chinese users, higher information density website is associated with lower usability and higher reliability.

articleTitle: A traffic partition method based on unsupervised classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper focuses on the traffic division problems. First the necessity of Traffic Division is described. Nine indicators are selected from the conditions of transportation facilities, traffic operating and traffic environment to research the urban traffic area. And then the theory of traffic division is researched by using unsupervised classification methods. On basis of this, urban traffic cluster system is explored. It has provided some useful information for the analysis and evaluation of urban transportation.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of cooperative spectrum sensing algorithm for cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Spectrum sensing is one of the critical tasks of the cognitive radio networks. In order to solve the hidden terminal problem, cooperative spectrum sensing has been studied to improve the spectrum sensing performance. In this paper, we study the performance of cooperative spectrum sensing in both AWGN channels and Rayleigh fading channels. In particular, the paper reports results obtained through the use of energy detector and compares the sensing performance under a variety of conditions.

articleTitle: A new adaptive synchronization scheme of delayed chaotic system for secure communication with channel noises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, a secure communication scheme of delayed chaotic system with channel noises is investigated. Based on the idea of chaotic cryptography, instead of encoding the message in a chaotic system signal directly, the plain signal is encrypted by using a multi-shift cipher scheme, which is more complicated and could increase the communication security. By using adaptive techniques, the transmitter and the receiver are synchronized in the presence of channel noises, and the encoded signal can be recovered by the receiver. Finally, theoretical analysis and numerical simulation show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A new genetic algorithm and tabu search for s-box optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A new s-box optimization method is presented based on genetic algorithm and tabu search, the algorithm was introduced the niche technology to maintain the population diversity and prevent premature convergence. And the S-box avalanche criteria, its diffusion and other performance characteristics so on are also as the target of evolution in order to further explore the optimization of s-box more. The experimental results show that the improved genetic tabu search algorithm based on S-box is feasible and effective, as it does have access to a number of S-boxes with high non-linearity and low differential uniformity.

articleTitle: Application of numerical simulation in the design of wire-mesh mist eliminator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Previous design of wire-mesh mist eliminator relies on enormous experiments and consumes a lot. In this paper, its pressure drop is simulated by numerical simulation, and non-simplified three-dimensional calculation model is established. After calculated under the flow velocity of 3-10m/s and compared it with the experimental data, the results show that the numerical simulation result achieves a very high precision. Meanwhile, the influence of different wire diameter and space between wire-mesh layers on the pressure drop of mist eliminators is studied and the proper space between wire-mesh layers within the scope of wire-diameter is 0.6mm-0.8mm. Two types of model were verified through the model experiment and the experimental error is less than 4%, which can be a theoretical guidance for designing mesh filter.

articleTitle: Error analysis in parallel robot using Edgeworth series and information entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, a new error analysis method in parallel robot using Edgeworth series and information entropy is proposed to address the accuracy issue in parallel robot. The pose error model of parallel robot is developed to quantify the pose error by using the mechanism error. Furthermore, the probability distribution function of the mechanism error and the pose error are obtained by using Edgeworth series, and an error information entropy model is developed to quantify the uncertainty of the pose error. The proposed analysis method is illustrated by implementing it to the pose error model of Stewart parallel robot in simulation. The simulation results show that the uncertainty relationship between the output pose error and the mechanism error.

articleTitle: The ASP system design of cluster supply chain management oriented to SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the large impact of economic globalization, along with the development of industrialization and urbanization in our country, a large number of inter-related enterprises have been assembled in a specified region based on economic links and the clusters of small and medium enterprises. However, we are still at the early stage of industry development and all small and medium enterprises(SMEs) have their own flaws, many problems appear in the cluster supply chains. On the basis of deep research of related papers and books this paper has considered comprehensively the actual situation of small and medium enterprise clusters and summarized the present problems and hot research fields. This paper has proposed that the platform of ASP should be used to improve the management of the supply chain of small and medium enterprise cluster so as to solve the corresponding problems. Besides, this paper has analyzed ASP structure, operation mode and ASP meaning.

articleTitle: A new method of object tracing based on similarity measure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper deals with object tracking in the video sequences. The goal is to determine in successive frames the object which best matches. Relying on the same principle of Chebyshev distance first, it can be distinguished by using the similar measure between reference object and candidate object in tracking. Hypothesis testing has been used to determine the follow-up strategies and tracking accuracy. The experiment results indicate that this method can avoid probability distribution of the estimated density function, reduce computing time as well as increase scientific property of the algorithm through statistical testing.

articleTitle: Improved hybrid genetic algorithm and its application in auto-coloring problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: An improved hybrid generic algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of the computation complexity and the sensitivity of initial selected population in auto-coloring. The algorithm combines the local search ability of greedy algorithm and the global search ability of genetic algorithm, as well as the specialized knowledge of graph coloring, using tabu rules to avoid repeated coloring and local circulation caused by the crossover process of generic algorithm. The infeasible solutions are forbad, and the next generation population are optimized so the implement efficiency of the algorithm can be increased. The simulation results show that the hybrid genetic algorithm can solve the problem of coloring administrative region map efficiently, improve both the implement efficiency and the convergence speed.

articleTitle: Fast automatic target detection of large scene SAR image based on parallel computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: An automatic target detection algorithm of SAR image based on parallel computing is presented in this paper. The experimental results based on constant false alarm rate detector verify that the algorithm adapts well to the parallel processing system with high performance and parallel efficiency. That means the algorithm has high real time property.

articleTitle: A simulation study of air-inflated seating comfort parameters on seating comfort
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, a model was built using visual.studio‥net.2005 to represent the relationship between Pcrms and different aspects of the cushion, such as cell radius, cell number, cell height, outlet number, outlet diameter, material elasticity driver weight in different cases. By analyzing these varied relations, each parameter's effect on comfort performance was determined according to the theory: when Pcrms decreases comfort performance will increase.

articleTitle: The research on the fundamental mode of Gridding E-commerce Logistic System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The construction of Gridding E-commerce Logistic System (ELS) which bases on the gridding management theory establishes different of management functional departments, the system control center and the center of reception, which can be as node resources management layer, the overall situation resources coordinated layer and the user service layer in the gridding management agency. It will define the various sectors of the job role, responsibilities, rights and operational process, and establish E-commerce Logistic System (ELS) based on gridding management theory, in order to compose and optimize of various resources.

articleTitle: Research on insulation resistance test for missile cables based on PC104 system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the analysis of existing insulation resistance test methods, a new test method is proposed. The structure of the software and hardware for the insulation resistance test instrurnent based on PC/104 is designed. The experimental results demonstrate the requirement of measurernent is achieved, such as, the test time is reduced. The system can perform efficiently, stably and reliably.

articleTitle: The flow field characters of a two-dimensional deformable wing heaving in a viscous flow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A systematic study for the flow around a deformable wing heaving in a prescribed motion at a Reynolds number of 104 is carried out through the numerical solution of the two-dimensional unsteady incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. Special attention is paid to the effect of the frequencies and amplitudes of the flexure wing on the wake structure and vortex shedding mechanism. The effect of flexible features on the forward flight of the wing is discussed by comparing the flow structures with those around a rigid wing. The simulation results reveal that the thrust efficiency of the deformable wing is higher than the rigid wing. The efficiency is improved because of flexure and is predominantly influenced by the reduced frequency.

articleTitle: Prediction of regional power generation based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Presently, with the rapid increase of China's electricity demand, fluctuation of power load as well as the continuous rise in coal prices, the electricity market generation side of some part region of China is facing risk. By the introduction of BP (Back Propagation) neural network theory, this paper established the regional power generation forecasting model, coal supply, policy implications, weather conditions, resources as well as competitive environment are quantified, then it was used as the network input as well as historical data of the regional power generation to forecast regional power generation as network output, calculate and analysis using by the established model. The outcome shows that this prediction was of full consideration of various factors and adjustment of the relationship between impact factors, it has the merits of minor error and high precision, and it is an effective method of regional power generation prediction.

articleTitle: Digital virtual assembly process design and assembly process simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper discusses the importance of the digital virtual assembly process design and the assembly process simulation technology, and it also discusses the product modeling and simulation technology, process modeling and simulation technology which are necessary for assembly procedure simulation. Combing with a specific research project, this paper introduces the crucial steps of the process modeling and simulation technology, namely analyzing the assembly characteristics, process planning, and assembly process simulation of the product object. In order to improve the fast response characteristics, the operation efficiency and the reliability of the manufacturing system, great importance should be attached to the process, namely the assembly process and assembly process plan of the product, which also means the research on the virtual assembly simulation technology and other technologies.

articleTitle: Design and analysis on automatic hydraulic transmission system of port tractor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: To improve the tractor handling stability and comfort, the automatic hydraulic transmission is designed based on the maximum speed and maximum traction of the tractor. The matching between engine and hydraulic torque converter is crucial to the performance of the automatic hydraulic transmission, and is important to the power performance and fuel consumption of vehicle. This paper developed a program to calculated and analyzed on the matching to improve the performance. At the same time, it presented the major technical parameters of the hydraulic automatic transmission and tested the new tractor. The tested results showed that the performance of the tractor had been greatly improved. It has practical value to the wide application of the hydraulic drive technology and is significant to raise the operating efficiency of transportation system.

articleTitle: A fuzzy comprehensive decision support model for information system flexibility evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: with the development of information system (IS) projects, it is an important problem to how to evaluate the flexible degree of enterprise information system. Firstly, this paper discusses the meaning of information system flexibility of enterprises, presents a three-dimension model of flexibility, and structures the flexibility granularity and the evaluation index system of information system flexibility. The method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) based on the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is analyzed step by step secondly. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the whole process of IS flexibility evaluation. Result of research has shown that this method is very effective.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of multi-track laser surface melting of 42CrMo steel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Laser surface melting (LSM) provides benefits over the conventional surface processes, including minimum distortion, high level of hardness and narrow heat-affected zone. One known problem about laser surface melting a large area by multi-track is overlapping. This research is focused on the development of a numerical model to study the effect of overlapping ratio on the hardness and stress distributions in multi-track laser surface melting. The results of hardness calculation have confirmed the microstructure changes in the material and shown that laser surface melting can be regarded as a highly successful method to improve the hardness of the 42CrMo steel. The hardness of the first track of melted area shows a slightly decrease under the effect of tempering by the second laser track. After multi-track laser surface melting, the compressive residual stress exists in the melted zone, while the tensile stress in the heat-affected zone (HAZ) and the boundary of overlapped area may cause the initiation of cracks. With the overlapping ratio increasing, the maximum stress in the surface of the specimen decreases.

articleTitle: An event-driven simulation model for the railway station
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A railway station system includes complex interconnections and interactions of several sub-systems. Computer simulation is an efficient means for system evaluation and analysis. This paper introduces an event-driven simulation framework which is flexible to reorganize the different models and easily extended to distributed system. Under this framework, the station civil infrastructure model, the signalling model and the rolling stock model are constructed.

articleTitle: Retransmission control for TDMA MAC in energy harvesting wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Energy harvesting wireless sensor networks ( EHWSN) are characterized by multihop wireless lossy links and resource constrained nodes that are able to harvest small amount of energy from ambient sources such as light, heat or vibration. For TDMA MAC protocols in EHWSN, redundancy and retransmission are two important methods to provide the high end-to-end data reliability. In this paper, for the TDMA MAC protocol, we propose a Reliability-Lifetime Tradeoff Framework (RLTF) for EHWSN to optimize the redundancy transmission number for each link. First, for the redundancy TDMA MAC, we formulate the RLTF as convex programming. By the gradient projection method, we develop a fully distributed algorithm to solve the convex programming. Second, for the retransmission TDMA MAC, we set the retransmission upper bound for each link according to the optimal redundancy number under the redundancy MAC and compute the total communication overhead for the retransmission MAC. Finally, we compare the communication overhead of these two MAC protocols under different channel conditions.

articleTitle: Research on shear model of ring joint bolts in stragger- jointed segmental linings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A new model of joints between lining circle is proposed according to the characteristic of stagger-jointed assembling shield tunnel. The method of ascertaining the parameters and the range of the parameters are given in this paper. Using this model, a qusi-3D simulation model is obtain to analysis the internal force of segmental linings in stagger-jointed assembling. The operation stage of a water diversion tunnel in Shanghai is analyzed, which indicates that the stagger-jointed assembling structure's relative displacement is less than straight-joint assembling structure and its internal force is larger than straight-joint assembling structure. It shows that the bilinear shear model is effective to reflect the constraint effect of stagger-jointed segmental linings of shield tunnel.

articleTitle: Research on three-dimensional roadway roaming system based on engine pattern
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The engine has become the development hypothesized simulation system's core technologies and the solution, this paper proposed a three-dimensional roadway roaming system, a common roaming architecture model; discussion of the use of the relatively more sophisticated collision detection algorithm, combined with bounding box algorithm and BSP technical processing Three-dimensional roadway system, collision detection. Combined W3C recommended standard SVG to propose the three dimensional roadway system based on the B/S architecture solution concept.

articleTitle: The generalized inverse eigenvalue problem for generalized periodic jacobi matrices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents the following inverse eigenvalue problem for generalized periodic Jacobi matrices:=given real numbers λ,μ, nonzero vectors x,y∈R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup> and a real matrix B. Find n×n real generalized periodic Jacobi matrices J (c<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf> = kb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>,k > 0,i = 1,…,n) such that Jx = λBx, Jy = μBy. The paper discussed the existence and uniqueness of the question's solution. And the expression of the solution of the problem is given, and some numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: A USB data acquisition system in chemical laboratory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In the chemical laboratory, sometimes it is necessary to monitor some data, and store them for analysis. So a multi-channel USB data acquisition system was designed in the paper to achieve the real-time and high-speed data acquisition which is needed. In the system, the slave computer was composed of 8051 and AD7819 as data acquisition module. And it was connect with the host computer through the USB interface device PDIUSBD12. The application of the system was designed with Visual Basic 6.0, which can develop windows applications easily. Through system debugging, The system can effectively complete the data acquisition when working with chemical sensors in the laboratory. The system will give our laboratory technician great help in many situations.

articleTitle: Robust algorithm for linearly constrained constant modulus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Linearly constrained constant modulus algorithm (CMA) is an effective blind adaptive beamforming. However, the constrained CMA suffers from severe performance degradation even if there is a small mismatch in the desired signal. In this paper, we propose a new approach to linearly constrained CMA that provides increased robustness against the mismatch problem. We modify the conventional CMA cost function by including a regularization term that penalizes differences between the actual and assumed array responses. The proposed algorithm can provides the significant improvement of the adaptive array performance and yield excellent signal capture ability. Simulation results are presented that illustrate the advantages of the proposed algorithm

articleTitle: Computer simulation of 40Gb/s optical fiber transmission systems with a fiber grating dispersion compensator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, high-bit-rate transmission systems with a chirped fiber grating dispersion compensator are investigated and simulated by solving nonlinear Schrödinger equations. Due to the effect of non-ideal dispersion and reflection characteristics of traditional apodized linearly chirped fiber gratings, the degradation of eye diagrams is very serious in 40Gb/s NRZ-transmission systems. Then, a dispersion compensator based on chirped fiber grating is designed by the layer peeling algorithm. After 40Gbit/s transmission over 800Km of standard single-mode fibers, the eye diagram is still clear, and the power penalty is only 0.45dB for this dispersion compensator. Simulation results show that: the chirped fiber grating designed by the layer peeling algorithm has excellent performances as the dispersion compensator in high-bit-rate transmission systems.

articleTitle: An effective Traffic Monitoring video segmentation method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the abrupt increase of motor vehicles, the advanced Intelligent Traffic Monitoring System (ITMS) has become a social hot spot in today's world. Automatic video segmentation plays an important role in the ITMS. Up to now, researchers have proposed several algorithms on automatic video segmentation. However, because of the large computation, many algorithms cannot be used for the real-time applications. In addition, some algorithms have many parameters to be set in advance. Shao-Yi Chien has proposed a fast video segmentation algorithm, which could meet real-time requirements. In this paper, we proposed an improved algorithm to get more accurate segmentation results from the traffic monitoring videos. With low computation load, the speed of this algorithm, which is running on a personal computer, can meet the real-time requirements. In order to optimize the results of segmentation, we have proposed a post processing algorithm to adjust the coarse segmentation. Experimental results show that our algorithms can give accurate segmentation results without complex computing.

articleTitle: Fast approximation of geodesic based on heuristic estimate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Geodesic computation is very important in various mesh processing techniques such as segmenting, re-meshing, parameterizing, navigating and editing. In this paper, we present a new method to quickly extract geodesic paths on 3D triangle meshes. Based on heuristic estimate and Dimas Martinez and Luiz Velho's evolving method, we generate an iterative process to obtain a good discrete geodesic approximation. It can handle convex and non-convex surfaces. Experiment results show that our method works very well both in efficiency and precision.

articleTitle: Study of oxygen-enriched combustion character on gasoline engine at cold-start
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: An investigation on the effects of oxygen-enriched combustion air on engine performance was extended to include the implications from the second law of thermodynamics. The use of oxygen enriched combustion air will have a direct affect on the combustion process and on the overall engine thermodynamics. For example, for cases with higher inlet oxygen concentration (and hence less nitrogen dilution), for the same operating conditions, the combustion gas temperatures and engine cylinder heat losses will be higher. Results include detail thermodynamic results of temperatures, pressures and properties as functions of the oxygen concentration of the combustion air. Other comparisons are reported.

articleTitle: Multi-camera calibration based on coplanar projection of points
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: To solve the problem of multi-camera calibration, an algorithm is brought forward based on coplanar projection of points. A coordinate system is unified between world coordinates and projective plane ones. After feature patterns projected onto a planar screen and corners extracted from images, each camera is calibrated respectively, from which it can obtain internal parameters and relative poses among cameras. Initial values of spatial points are derived from projective transformation. Then it finds out corresponding points of each image pair by epipolar geometry constraint and calculates spatial points in terms of triangle principle again. Root mean square error between initial values and estimation values are calculated. Furthermore, it eliminates points until errors of all spatial points within threshold. The experimental analyses indicate that the algorithm can reduce computational complexity and manual intervention. Calibration accuracy can meet the need.

articleTitle: Research of ontology-based platform for insects Digital Museum
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to classify a wide variety of insect resources and to achieve effective database storage or efficient retrieval in an insect Digital Museum, this paper introduce ontology model first then describe an insects ontology model, which leads to unified insect resources, so that users can easily obtain the resources when needed in the Insect Resource Management Center.

articleTitle: Improved Concentric Clustering Routing Scheme adapted to various environments of sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Wireless sensor networks consist of sink nodes and multiple sensor nodes that monitor environmental conditions such as pressure, temperature, etc. The main constraint associated with sensor nodes is energy consumption. The Extended Concentric-Clustering Routing Scheme ECCRS is a hybrid mechanism that unifies the chain-based scheme PEGASIS and the clustering scheme. In this paper, we improve the energy consumption in ECCRS further by improving the energy and distance parameters. In our approach, the sensor field is divided into various levels and each level has the same node density as well as the same number of nodes, for which the radius of each level is adjusted accordingly. To improve the energy factor in ECCRS, our proposed scheme creates a set of probable candidates for cluster heads. The cluster head formation of a level from its probable candidate set takes into account the minimum distance between the higher level cluster head the nodes of the probable candidates set of the same level. The simulation results show that our approach is 13% more efficient as compared to ECCRS in terms of energy consumption.

articleTitle: An efficient polling scheme for wireless LANs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the popularity of WLAN application how to meet the requirements of various applications and perform more efficiently on the limited bandwidth of wireless networks becomes a key problem. This paper suggest a new scheme of MAC protocol of WLAN, making possible the service of the two-class priority station polling system under the mixed policy of exhaustive and gated services, optimizing the services of the system in time of load change input via adjustment of the times of the access gated services, and strengthening the flexibility and fairness of multimedia transmissions in wireless networks. The theoretical model is established with discretetime Markov chain and probability generating function. The analyses demonstrate that this scheme enables an effective allocation of channel resources for different tasks, guarantees the quality of system services.

articleTitle: Improved adaptive leap particle swarm algorithm dynamic optimization method against electromechanical coupling system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Dynamic optimization of electromechanical coupling system is a multi-subject problem on mechanics theory. The optimization of such kind problem is studied. Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is introduced. In order to resolve the insufficiency, a new kind of adaptive leap particle swarm optimization (ALPSO) is presented and the astringency analysis is finished. Finally, ALPSO is used to optimize electromechanical coupling reshape machine tool principal axis system. The results of application example proved that practical optimization parameters can be obtained in limited time by the method, and it is a kind of effective way to solve such kind of problem.

articleTitle: Research of flow calculation system based on texture analysis and ROI tracking
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Due to affecting by the human body irregular movement or other appendage while detecting human traffic in the channel, the accuracy of flow calculation system is unsatisfactory. We propose a new robust way to detect and count walking persons in channel areas, which mainly includes four aspects: (1) to avoid the human bodies being blocked mutually by vertically fixed monochromatic cameras; (2) to determine the approximate movement region by a simple background subtraction approach; (3) to confirm the pedestrians' head region by windows' sliding match in movement regions of continuous frames based on analysis of similar texture, which are as region-of-interests (ROIs); (4) to track ROIs in the next frame images by the ROI tracking algorithm and count ROIs of passing count line. The test shows that the method can effectively solve problems of shadows and the segmenting pedestrians counted in channels, and improve the accuracy of flow calculation system.

articleTitle: An improved similarity algorithm based on Stability Degree for item-based collaborative filtering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With an exponentially growing amount of information being added to the Internet, finding efficient and valuable information is becoming more difficult. Collaborative Filtering acts a very important role in web service personalization and Recommender System. In this paper, Stability Degree was proposed to improve the accuracy of Item based collaboration filtering, three kinds of Stability Degree were introduced into similarity computation, and the results show that the prediction accuracy can be improved by 25 percents.

articleTitle: Design of a visualization system of sequential logic chip based on SVG
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the development of large scale integrated circuit, the complexity of the chip has increased, and the analysis has become more difficult. This paper presents a new sequential logic chip analysis method-the state transition diagram visualization analysis method, which solves the low efficiency of traditional chip analysis method, and mainly describes design proposal and implementation procedure of visualization, and gives a way to analyze the security of sequential logic chips, and test the system with instances to verify the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Derived embodiment: Interrogating posthuman identity through the digital avatar
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper investigates the question of posthuman identity via the trope of the avatar and proposes an alternative model for its conceptualization and formulation through the framework of derived embodiment, whereby the posthuman construct is determined not by the independence of its digital data nor the disavowal of real-life bodily experience, but by the derivation of embodiment as presence enmeshed with information. Employing the theories of, among others, Maurice Merleau-Ponty, Vivian Sobchack and Elizabeth Grosz, I argue that the interrogation of posthuman identity should be conducted through a more nuanced strategy of slippage between real and virtual worlds, specifically in two ways: (i) ascertaining the unique embodiment of the avatar by examining its specific actions and behaviour in virtual worlds; and (ii) mining the interstices of experiences between the real and the virtual, whereby the user's control and activation of the avatar translates into sensorium, embodied memory and sensory perception. The result of this paper is to present the avatar as an alternative text to assert the posthuman identity of an information-processing being embedded and enmeshed with the tactility and sensuality of derived embodiment.

articleTitle: A PTAS for embedding a directed hypergraphin a tree of rings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: We study the problem of embedding a directed hypergraph in a tree of rings which has applications in optimal network communication. Such problems are NP-complete, therefore we are interested in searching for an approximate solution (to arbitrary accuracy) within polynomial time. In this paper, we present a polynomial time approximation scheme (PTAS) for the problem of directed hypergraph embedding in a tree of rings.

articleTitle: Developing of mobile-game based on J2ME technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the research and analysis of mobile telephone game development technology, this dissertation has studied the theory and implementation of the 2D mobile telephone game engine framework based on J2ME. This dissertation introduced the key development problems, such as: how to control the game flow, how to paint the animation and how to respond key-press events, and also introduced the corresponding solutions. Aim to practice application; the dissertation implemented a mobile telephone game. The reflection of this software is very good, indicated the design thoughts are appropriate. Finally, this dissertation discussed the transplant methods.

articleTitle: A Framework for supporting consistent lookup in Distributed Hash Table
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: There are many structured P2P systems that use Distributed Hash Table (DHT) to map data items onto the nodes in various ways for scalable routing and location. DHT are algorithms used in modern peer-to-peer applications, which provides a reliable, scalable and efficient way to manage peer-to-peer networks. As a fundamental problem in DHT based P2P system, the efficient location of the node that stores a desired data item, performance and consistent lookup are important to avoid performance degradation and guarantee system fairness. This paper presents a structural prevention strategy to remove inconsistent lookups on the basic that inconsistent lookup is generated by inconsistent routing tables. The algorithms keep the routing tables consistent with the state of the nodes in DHT and maintain a ring structure guaranteeing consistent lookup results in the presence of node joins and leaves. The goal is to be able to trust a lookup result to give the actual state of the DHT.

articleTitle: Motion mechanism and simulation of the human jumping robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The jumping procedure of the human was captured with a high-speed video camera. The geometrical configurations and motion postures of the human during jumping were analyzed from the high-speed photographs. By biological observation and kinematic analysis, the human jump was divided into stance phase, flight phase and land phase. Based on the observation, the human jump was simplified and a mechanical model was put forward. The velocity and the torque of the hip joint, knee joint and ankle joint of the limb were analyzed. It was shown that the changes of hip joint angle were more remarkable, which provided the driving force for the body. The results would provide some theoretical and practical references for biomimetic design for improving the reasonable motion of the jumping robot. This work may provide the basic theory in developing human jumping robot in structural design. Besides, it provides an important reference to study the other bionic robots.

articleTitle: Research on digital design of the marine power plant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The marine power plant traditional design method was popular introduced when the computer design and application had not yet appeared. Based on the analysis of the problems of the traditional design method of the marine power plant, the issue that applying digital design method to the design process of the marine power plant was studied in this paper. The digital design scheme for the marine power plant was proposed, and the key problems was studied. The research in the paper could help to improve the design of the marine power plant.

articleTitle: Electronic bus stop boards promote the intelligent construction of urban public transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Public transportation is an important component of urban transportation, this paper puts forward taking electronic bus stop boards as carriers and integrating technical means, such as GPS, GIS, digital bulletin and 3G net, etc, to realize the integrated solution of accurate bus station reporting, platform security protection, passenger SOS and public information release.

articleTitle: Study on structural parameters of a six-axis accelerometer for humanoid robot hand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to counteract disturbance by acceleration and ensure the grasp robustness of the multi-fingered robot hand, the paper presented a six-axis accelerometer used parallel mechanism as the structure of sensing element, established static mathematical model, deduced the expression of Jacobian for accelerometer. According to Jacobian, the important static characteristic indices were defined to optimize so many structural parameters, which were used to analyze the relationship between indices and structural parameters of sensing element. Based on the definition of the indices, the structural parameters were designed by the physical model of solution space. Applied to a computing example, the theoretical strain and experimental strain of each leg were acquired to verify the effectiveness of the method. Simultaneously, FEM simulation experimental results show that the six-axis accelerometer has the good dynamic characteristic for humanoid robot hand.

articleTitle: Methods study of improving efficiency of large-scale software development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: How to improve the efficiency of large-scale software development has been a hot topic in software engineering. This article explores and proposes a new high-efficiency development method with practical experience in software outsourcing to Japan, automatically generates standardized program based on the functional-driven, and also automatically generate test cases based on the testing theory. This method has good scalability and operability, there are realistic significance to development patterns based on .NET, J2EE frameworks.

articleTitle: Study on site selection about reverse logistics testing center based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the application of the global version of the particle swarm algorithm in the center location of the continuity of the convergence, it is indeed faster than before, however, being easy to fall into local optimum. The introduction of ALA ideas put forward to solve such a model of particle swarm optimization algorithm. The algorithm first to use local optimization ability of ALA to optimize the initial particles, and then use the particle swarm optimization algorithm for global optimization. Several examples show that the algorithm can handle the continuous location problem of testing center for policy-makers, also, providing an effective optimization tools.

articleTitle: An approach of Support Vector Machine to improve the training speed
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: When training a Support Vector Machine (SVM) we need to solve a very large convex optimization problems, typically Quadratic Programs (QP) that will largely reduce the solving speed of SVM. An improved algorithm to speed up training of SVM is proposed. The algorithm uses the fact that the solution of the QP is same if you remove the training samples that correspond to zero Lagrange multipliers. The training samples of zero Lagrange multipliers are nonsupport vectors. The samples located in the center of the training samples are nonsupport vectors. We can identify the samples in the center of the training samples and remove them using variance in statistics to decrease training samples as much as possible. In the paper, the balance factor that is the key parameter is analyzed and its value range is provided. Simulation experiments are performed using the databases including an artificial and an UCI real data. Simulation experiments indicate that the improved algorithm can cut down the training time of SVM by 80% while the ability of SVM to classification is unaffected. This approach is practicable.

articleTitle: Study on application of computer educational technology in college PE teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: It is more popular to apply such modern technology as multimedia and remote network in many other subjects, while this application in college PE teaching is waiting for improvement. The application of computer technology can make the college PE teaching more vivid, more visual and more intuitive. Its multi-dimension, integration and interaction play a very important role in improving the teaching efficiency, stimulating students' learning enthusiasm, changing the traditional teaching ideas and methods. With the research approaches like literature review, expert interview, logic analysis, etc, relevant studies are carried out on the application of computer technology in college PE teaching and are expected to provide some references for realizing the teaching aim.

articleTitle: Identification of the mineral oil fluorescence spectroscopy based on the ICA and SVM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Spectral features of the different kinds of the mineral oil are different from each other, so the oil can be identified by the spectral data based on the principle. The composed of it with aromatic hydrocarbons structure is very often complicated, which caused the three-dimensional fluorescence spectroscopy of the different oil are various. The characteristic of the oil style-book are difficult to be maintained by the simple formula when the three-dimensional fluorescence spectroscopy technology is used to identify the species of the mineral oil. In this paper, the independent component analysis (ICA) is used to do the matrix decomposition from the perspective of independence to extract the main feature of the spectroscopy. The support vector machine (SVM) is used to assort the main characteristic root books which are abstracted by the ICA. The species identification of the mineral oil will be realized by it. The identification result is visualized by the parallel coordinate's graph. The experiment results show that it is effective to extract the main feature of the spectroscopy. The classify speed is greatly increased. The discrimination is 98.56. It can effectively realize the identification of the oils.

articleTitle: Image inpainting algorithm based on contour features and improved MVSC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Image inpainting is an important content in the image recovery research area, and also is a research hot spot in the computer graphics and computer vision in the current. Two major categories image inpainting techniques are introduced. After Pre-processing, we get gray image and using contour extraction algorithm to extract the contour features of damaged area, which determine the contour feature location. Area-based matching algorithm is used to search alternative matching area. Contour-based Similarity Distance function (CSD) is used to determine the most similar matching area. According to the damaged area and the matching area, the source cloning domains and target cloning domains of MVSC algorithm is improved. Using mean value coordinates to achieve regional pixel cloning from the source cloning domain to the target cloning domain. Finally, the improved MVSC algorithm is used to repair the image. Experimental results verified that the method can not only repair small-scale scratches, but also repair a large area damaged areas.

articleTitle: A rectification algorithm for distorted images from the inclination plane paper
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we deal with the problem of image rectification with the images captured by digital cameras at an angle. The procedure of forensic photography requires that the film plane should be paralleled to a taken image. Another procedure must be followed when the print is located on reflexible surfaces such as vehicles, or faint marks on porous surfaces. Examinations were made of the evidential value of mark images which were received from the scene or taken deliberately at an angle out of proper perspective (i.e., the lens axis is not perpendicular to the target plane). Based on geometry of differential and projection as well as the theory of imaging optics, a robust and fast inclination rectification algorithm is proposed using perspective transform of camera lens, and validated using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Texture characteristic extraction of medical images based on pyramid structure wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to extract image texture features of medical images, pyramid structure wavelet (PWT) is used in this paper. A group of gray-scale images of chest CT from medical image database are selected as test set. The PWT using three different wavelets bases db6, db2 and Haar are carried out to extract texture feature of each image respectively. A method called symmetric circular extension which takes the boundary as symmetric center are utilized to overcome data increasing and large errors existed nearby reconstructed signal. Empirical results show that the texture feature of chest CT images is mainly concentrated in the low frequency part. However, LH, HL and HH sub-bands contain only less than 7% of the total energy. The PWT using haar wavelet basis extracts more information than it using db2 and db6 wavelet basis. For texture analysis of medical images, the PWT algorithm using haar wavelet base can improve the performance of feature extraction of each sub-band.

articleTitle: An effective SCOP-based adaptive control method for widening interference nulls
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A new adaptive beamforming method is presented to widen nulls of adaptive antenna array. The presented method utilizes the second-order cone programs (SCOP) to improve the beamforming control performances. This proposed method can provide increased robustness against the mismatch problem as well as control over the sidelobe level. In addition, the proposed method can widen the width of nulls for interference signal sources. Simulation results are presented to illustrate the performance achievable.

articleTitle: The prediction of warp breakage rate of weaving by considering sized yarn quality using artificial neural network theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Artificial neural network methods are established and designed to predict the warp breakage rate. The objective of this paper is to investigate the predictability of the warp breakage rate from a sizing yarn quality index using a feed-forward back-propagation network in an artificial neural network system. In order to achieve the objective, a series of trial is conducted. The good correlation between predicted and actual warp breakage rates indicates that warp breakage rates can be predicted by neural networks, the model with a single tanh hidden layer with 8 neurons is able to produce better predictions than the other models of this particular data set in the work. The experimental results and the corresponding analysis show that the artificial neural network model is an efficient technique for the quality prediction and has wide prospect in the application of the textile industry.

articleTitle: Study on digital processing technology of the multidimensional graph in Mechanical Design Handbook
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The graphs in Mechanical Design Handbook are mostly obtained through mathematical statistical analysis and curve fitting of the discrete experimental data, most of which have irregular or even changing constraints, but no obvious regularity. In manual design, designers can more easily obtain the relevant information from the graph by checking table or using the measuring tool to take points on the curve, but the efficiency is very low. To effectively solve this problem, we can use the computer's fast retrieval and automatic point selection and calculation to obtain the required information from the graph, but firstly we must digitize these graphs so as to convert them into the analytical expression group which computer can recognize. Digital processing technology of the multidimensional graph is explored in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of polling multiple access system for tactical data link by Matlab Stateflow modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: By utilizing the MATLAB Stateflow tool, which is developed by finite-state machine theory, this paper constructed a tactical data link networks model. The model adopted the gated polling scheme with priority control service under the condition of 3, 5 and 10 stations involved in the networks respectively. The station with higher priority can be prior served through interrupting other station's information transmitting. From the simulation experiments, the delay characteristics of the stations and networks under various transfer rate have be shown and analyzed, especially for Link 11 system. As a result, it is concluded that the polling mechanism and modeling method proposed by authors are effective for the tactical data link modeling and analysis.

articleTitle: Rapid burst-mode signal detecting method based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Signal detection plays a crutial role in Burst-mode communication. This paper proposed a Non-data-aided rapid signal detection method in burst-mod preambless demodulation, which could detect the beginning and ending of the burst frame. The system design has been analysed and verified by the simulation and an implementation suitable for FPGA application has been developed using an altera stratixII target system‥

articleTitle: Fractal-based 3d tree modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we propose an approach for generating three dimension (3D) models of trees base on fractal idea that has the benefit of offering automatically and interactively modeling. The approach can generate 3D geometry tree using botanical knowledge and the fractals, can automatically generate photorealistic tree in real-time, also provides the capability for the user to control shape of the tree in a parameterized way as compared with rule-based tree modeling systems. The approach is very useful in practices and generates visually convincing results.

articleTitle: Fieldbus technology and rolling process automation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Fieldbus technology is the product of the development automation, computer and intelligence instruments technology. Rolling process automation is improved with development of rolling technology, control theory and fieldbus technology. It reviews the brief description of fieldbus technology. After summarizing the development of its relevant control theory, control technology and control instrument, analyzing the characters of distributed control system and fieldbus control system and considering the characters of rolling process, a new distributed control structure of rolling mill based on fieldbus is presented, and it is meet with the request of expansion, maintenance and manipulation of rolling control structure.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of mine high voltage switch permanent magnetic actuator intelligent control technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In view of the traditional mine high voltage switch actuator (electromagnetic and electric spring) having poor movement reliability and slow response speed, it is difficult to achieve precise control of mechanical movement. Considering the requirement of high voltage vacuum interrupter opening and closing quickly, bi-stable permanent magnetic actuator in which adding adjusting coil is used in the paper to meet the mine operating condition's requirement. DSPTMS320LF2407 is used to design intelligent control unit mainly composed of detection, control, protection, CAN communication function and so on. It makes use of RBF neural network to predict the opening and closing time of moving contact to achieve synchronous closing of high voltage switch, and has greatly improved the quality of coal mine power supply and protected the coal mine safety in production.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of cage in high speed cylindrical roller bearing based on flexible vody method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper attempt to achieve a more accuracy simulation of high speed cylindrical bearing cage's dynamic performance. Considering the flexibility of cage, dynamic equations of cylindrical roller bearing in high speed in main-shaft of aero-engine was established using modified Craig-Bampton substructure mode synthesis method. Rigid-flexible dynamic simulation software of cylindrical roller bearing was developed based on the commercial software MSC. ADAMS. High speed cylindrical roller bearing simulations were carried out with different working condition, structure parameters, all the effect of these parameters were studied based on the simulation results. The results show that fatigue failure caused by vibration stress may occur at intersectional point of the cage bar and side bar. High-speed and lightly-load can result in large slip of cage, the change of inner ring speed has some more influence on slip ratio than that of outer ring. The cage pocket/guide clearance ratio can remarkably affect the bearing's stability; the simulation results suggest that a small value should be selected. The slip ratio of flexi-blew cage is slightly larger than that of the rigid one, which accords with the experimental date better.

articleTitle: A kind of the inverse eigenvalue problem for five-diagonal matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents a kind of the inverse eigenvalue problem for the real five-diagonal matrix: Given three real numbers unequal, three nonzero real vectors, another n-2 real numbers as well as the constant k. Find n order real five--diagonal matrices B, such that the establishment of three equations with matrix B and the known information. Where, B are the matrices with proportional relation on minor diagonal and the second minor diagonal. Another n-2 real numbers are the elements of the second minor diagonal in super-diagonal matrix. Discussed necessary and sufficient conditions of the unique solution of the existence, then the expression of the solution of the problem is given, and a numerical example is provided.

articleTitle: Feedback phase-shift controlling for dual-ring erbium-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The physical model of single-ring feedback phase-shift controlling and the model of dual-ring feedback phase-shift controlling are proposed in this text according to the method of chaos feedback phase-shift for dual-ring erbium-doped fiber laser. On this basis, the output of system was simulated by computer. After synthetically analyzing the simulating result, we reached a conclusion that it's effective to control the output into chaos state, stable state or periodic state. By comparison, we knew the feedback coefficient and feedback phase-shift have a different impact on different models.

articleTitle: Matching location algorithm of corn image projection based on over-segmentation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Fast and accurate positioning of corn image is premise for variable spray between plants. In order to improve the real-time and stability of matching algorithm for complex scenes tracking in the field, firstly, over-segmenting method is applied to eliminate the interference of weeds and noise in this paper. Then, the datum template which is morphological stable root image is adopted to match and locate with the target block by projection method. This method greatly reduces the complexity of the conventional template-matching algorithm. Therefore, the adaptability and stability of location algorithm are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Study on the efficiency of electric consumption in China and its determinants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: DEA method is used in this paper to measure the electric energy efficiency of 29 regions in China from 2000 to 2008. And then Panel Data model is used to test the determinants of the electric energy efficiency in China. The result shows that the efficiency in different regions has big difference, and the R&D expenditures,the proportion of secondary industry in GDP, the price index of materials, fuel and power are negatively related with the electric energy efficiency, and per capita GDP is positively related with the electric energy efficiency.

articleTitle: SVM-based target tracking in combined with Sensor Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A new target tracking method is presented to improve target location accuracy in the case of prolonging the network lifetime. The presented method utilizes sensor scheduling to extend the network lifetime and support vector machine for target tracking. Analysis and simulation results show that the algorithm has a high target localization accuracy by comparing with the least-square location method.

articleTitle: The trusted measurement enhanced for security of mobile agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper discussed a security scheme of mobile agent on trusted computing platform. The security architecture of mobile agent based on trusted measurement was constructed by using the trusted measurement policy and trust chain mechanism provided by trusted computing platform. Furthermore, the mathematic model of trust relationship was also constructed among mobile agent platforms based on trusted measurement in the distributed computing environment of mobile agent. Then the experimental numerical value simulation and test validation were processed.

articleTitle: Research on parametric modeling of poplar based on hierarchy structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Trees' computer modeling has been widely used in the construction of a virtual natural scene. Poplar, as a common tree species in mid-latitude region, is very essential in real landscape. Up to now, in the models libraries of many commonly used applications on tree growth simulation, it is hard to find poplar species models. In this paper, the result of analysis and statistics on measured shape parameters and data trends of some 3-year Populur × euramericana cv. “74/76” (Poplar 107) trees was shown at first. And then models of Poplar 107 were established using a hierarchical parameter modeling method. At the last part, further study was prospected. The established models of Poplar trees can make construction of landscape with poplars rapid and facilitated greatly.

articleTitle: The research of the constructing plant model based on the parametric L-system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Computer simulation of the growth process of plants is one of the important representation of the agricultural informatization. But various of existing methods by which plant model is structed can't simulate it efficiently. The paper proposes the method of using the combination of parameter L - System and turtle, and introduces it in detail. Besides, the method takes gravity factor in consideration in the L - System model formula. Finally, using the simulation results show that this method can effectively solve the plant's structure design difficulties.

articleTitle: A new organization for Microprogrammed Control units
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The control unit in chap 5 of computer system architecture by M.Morris Mano is designed by using Hardwired Control that in this paper aforesaid control unit is designed by using Microprogrammed Control. this control organization better than other control organization This paper describes the main features of microprogramming to improve the performance of this computer systems.

articleTitle: MPI and OpenMP paradigms on cluster with multicores and its application on FFT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: At present the cluster of workstation with multicores is most popular in high performance architecture. However, pure MPI paradigm can't benefit from the computing capability of multicores. Parallel programming can combine distributed memory parallelization with shared memory parallelization. And hybrid MPI+OpenMP may be a superior solution because of its less communication, declined consumption of the memory, and improved load balance. In this paper, we propose an improved parallel FFT algorithm based on hybrid architecture and the results shows the algorithm has good scalability and high efficiency.

articleTitle: D - stability analysis for discrete system with time delay
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: By functional analysis and eigenvalue analysis methods in complex plane, several useful criteria are deduced which can guarantee that all the eigenvalues of discrete time-delay systems are located in a given region D(α, r) (with center (α,0) and radius r ) in the cases that the system matrix A is diagonalizable and A is a normal matrix. These criteria are simple to complete and can be used to solve the D - stability analysis problem for discrete time-delay systems, therefore they can optimize the dynamic performance of the system. The system is D - stable if the criteria are satisfied. And the criteria also can be applied to the case of real plane. Two examples are included to illustrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the criteria.

articleTitle: Simulation of fractals formation using AutoCAD software
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper four procedures were developed using AutoLISP computer language and were run in AutoCAD Software for simulating fractals formation. These fractals include Koch curve, Koch snowflake, tree shape, and Sierpinski triangle. Comparison with previous simulations, these simulated fractals can be magnified and minified under any view scale using the zoom and pan functions of AutoCAD Software, so the details and the whole of Fractals can be further researched and observed.

articleTitle: Full-scale 3D reconstruction contributes to micro-CT stereological assessments of osteoporotic proximal tibial cancellous bone in rats
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Micro-computerized tomography (micro-CT) has become one of the very important and useful tools for research of bone microarchitecture. In order to achieve correct stereological assessments for cancellous bone with osteoporotic changes, a full-scale three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction with optimal positioning method was designed and used. In this study, a rat model of bone microstructure disorganization was induced by carbon tetrachloride (CCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) administration. Then experimental osteoporosis in rats was proved by dual energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA). Application of our full-scale 3D reconstruction followed by its micro-CT stereological assessments of proximal tibial cancellous bone in osteoporotic rats resulted in better recognization and understanding of osteoporotic properties in the special and irregular bone. In conclusion, our results suggest that the full-scale 3D reconstruction based stereology is very eligible for evaluation of microstructural properties of osteoporotic cancellous bone in a special and irregular bone.

articleTitle: Equilibrium stableness of capability screening in collaborative information seeking under fuzzy condition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The paper set out to provide a mechanism of contract design in collaborative information seeking(CIS) under fuzzy condition. It studied the service provider's investment decision in CIS project and investigated how did enterprise induce the service providers' behaviors by tuning its own intelligence quality standard in contract, which on the separate equilibrium path. It also constructed a fault tree model in CIS that could analyze the reliability of the equilibrium in the signaling game model under fuzzy condition.

articleTitle: The research of on-line monitoring instrument for distribution transformers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: An on-line distribution transformer parameter monitoring instrument was developed by using the double CPU parallel processing technology. The dual-port RAM was used to realize the communication between the MCU and DSP. It makes full use of the advantages of DSP and MCU. The experimental results show that the instrument has the high cost performance ratio and high reliability.

articleTitle: The judgment method of valid objects and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: There is little room for doubt about Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) as a strong tool to be used in many domains, such as cognitive science, etc. Concept lattice is the basic data structure in FCA, and it is induced by contexts. A context is an incidence matrix that shows the relationship between objects and attributes. Attributes often share hierarchical relations which decide the form of objects. Based on attribute hierarchy, valid/invalid object were defined, the judgment method of valid/invalid object was developed on the relation between reachability matrix and valid objects, and valid object was explained from the perspective of graph theory. The judgment algorithm of valid object was proposed. The analysis of the algorithms also showed linear growth with respect to the number of valid objects. Mathematical models with 10 attributes were built for the algorithms by linear regression analysis.

articleTitle: A network disk encryption with dynamic encryption key
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
