abstract: The safety problem of network storage is much more important than accessibility and usability. In this paper, we present a novel network disk encryption approach basing on dynamic encryption key to protect user data. Firstly, the encryption key is dynamically created for the user, and then user data uploaded to the network disk is encrypted with the dynamic encryption key. Without the dynamic encryption key, others can not get the content of encrypted files. We developed a safe network disk prototypical system to prove our approach.

articleTitle: The research on factors of the distance learners' motivation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: By literature review, five categories of factors were found to impact the distance learners' motivation. Then explore the relationship between academic motivation and it's impact factors, as well as how the factors can predict the academic motivation level of distance learners. This study was to investigate the level of distance learner's academic motivation and what kinds of factors impact it. Finally, some suggestions are made to improve academic motivation for the distance learners.

articleTitle: Study on finite buffer queue scheduling with polling and reservation strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A finite buffer queue scheduling with polling and reservation strategy for the network node is designed. Because the delay sensitive service and the non-delay sensitive service need the different quality of service, they will gain the different services through scheduling transmission rate. A three-dimension Markov queue model is proposed to investigate the queue scheduling model in this paper. The queue is analyzed by using the linear level reduction algorithm and quasi birth and death process. The performance measures are derived including mean queue length, mean waiting time and blocking probability of delay sensitive service and the non-delay sensitive service, etc.

articleTitle: Robust fuzzy control based on disturbance observer in fight simulation turntable
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A robust fuzzy control method based on disturbance observer is put forward for DCS simulation turntable system, employing the frequency characteristic to design filters and analysing the functions and effects of filters comparatively. Experiments and trials show that under the external disturbance and parameter perturbation, such method can guarantee the high accuracy, stability and excellent tracing property of flight simulation turntable system.

articleTitle: Service-oriented design part information semantic modeling and applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Networked manufacturing enterprises need a wider support from external manufacturing resources. This paper proposes a promising service to use web-based extended part resources for product development. The system architecture and enabling techniques are presented. Manufacturing part resources on the web are organized with semantic web technologies. These resources are further utilized through web-based resource repositories such as part libraries. The major modules of web-based part services are encapsulated with web services. Some preliminary results indicate the feasibility and scalability of web-based manufacturing resource services for networked manufacturing.

articleTitle: Estimation on lightning protection performance using a fractal approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Modeling and estimation of lightning protection systems are very important for the lightning protection design. In this paper, an estimation algorithm on lightning protection performance at 1-m resolution was proposed based on the 3-D dielectric breakdown model (DBM). With the thundercloud model and Laplace's equation in the space, the DBM model was implemented using a fractal approach. When the tip of the downward stepped leader had reached a height of 100m above the ground, the resolution near the protection device was transformed from 50m to 1m. In the refined estimation area, the leader continued progressing according to the DBM model. Through the application of this approach to estimate the protection performance on a kind of lightning protection system, the cumulative probability distributions in different distances near the lightning protection device could be obtained, and the correlative influencing factors leading to the result were also analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on electronic commerce platform base on distributed model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper studies the development of distributed e-commerce platform and points out a solution for e-commerce platform. Firstly, it analyzes the characteristics of the distributed model e-commerce platform, and then proposes a distributed model which consists of e-business platform architecture, platform, traders, customers, business center. At last, it analyzes the function modules and the operational process, which can realize the commodity trade and support both the computer and the mobile phone users.

articleTitle: An improved Snake model and its application in targets detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A novel image edge extraction method is presented to overcome the shortcomings such as sensitive to initial situation, low constringency in the energy minimum process of the traditional Snake model method. The 2D discrete wavelet transformation and LUM filter method are combined to pre-treat the image, and then a novel external force model is built to compute the external energy, and finally the wavelet-pyramid method is combined with the improved Snake model, which is the so-called wavelet-pyramid-improved-snake model to extract the image edge. The experiments of the edge extraction of fighter plane edge proved the effectiveness of the present method.

articleTitle: Application research on a persistent technique based on Hibernate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Hibernate is a very excellent ORM framework which allows developers to access database by using object- oriented approach. This paper offers a specific implementation programme of the application persistent theory based on Hibernate through the research on persistent theory and the related technology of Hibernate.

articleTitle: Numerical study on the effect of trajectory pattern on hovering flight
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A systematic aerodynamic analysis for the wing of a micro flying robot hovering with different kinematics at a Reynolds number of 140 is carried out through the numerical solution of the two-dimensional time-dependent incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. Special attention is paid to the effect of the stroke trajectories on the aerodynamic forces and vortex shedding mechanism of the hovering wing. Six types of trajectory are selected which are line, oval, inverse-oval, eight, inverse-eight and double-eight, and for each case a harmonic hovering pattern is examined. In addition, the fruitfly hovering trajectory is also analyzed. A quantitative comparison of the aerodynamic forces and vortex structure between different trajectories is present. The simulation results reveal that the varied trajectory pattern results in significant differences in vortex structure around the wing, which indicates that an appropriate stroke deviation can be used to steer the maneuverable performance of the micro flying robot.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization conceptual design of solar energy product based on hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: For research on conceptual design of the complex product, it is necessary that a reliable theory is found to decide if the design structure is suit for custom requirement. The correlation matrixes among requirements, functions and structures are proposed. A block diagonal matrix of correlation matrix between functions and structures is given. The mathematical models of multi-object optimization structure design are provided, and then calculated by the hybrid genetic algorithm. An example for solar energy automobile is given to show that this method is able to realize optimization structure design fitting for the requirements. In addition, the approaches can provide good Pareto optimization solutions.

articleTitle: The design and utilization of middle school virtual experiment based on Flash coordinate transformation- Taking Ohm's Law for example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In response to lack of funding and hardware equipments in middle school physics experiment teaching and the low accuracy of multi-media courses in stimulating physics experiments, a middle school physics virtual experiment based on Flash coordinate transformation was put forth, with middle school experiment “Ohm's Law” as an example, providing foundation for the design and development of virtual experiments.

articleTitle: Probabilistic neural network and its application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Nuclear marine apparatus is a huge complicated system, most of which equipments are of nonlin-earity, time varying, coupling and inexactness. Neuralnet is widely applied in nuclear fault diagnosis for its approaching any kinds of nonlinearity mapping. At present, BP neural net is used more widely, but the layers of the net and the neurones on each layer can not be delimited easily; such net may fall into the minimum point in the course of training. In this essay, PNN proves effective in diagnosing faults on nuclearmarine apparatus.

articleTitle: The analysis of task scheduling in embedded software test environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the discussion and analysis of typical task schedule algorithms, a static scheduling algorithm based on RM used in the framework of the test environment is proposed in this paper. Task types are classified according to the test running law. The characteristics of the tasks used in test environment which are model task, script task and system task are analyzed in detail. Based on the analysis of these different task characteristics task schedule architecture used for test environment are presented and discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Discussion on CORS data storage method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to solve the problems of mass geographic information and CORS data storage and information sharing, the paper firstly analyzed the data of Continuous Operating Reference Station, the results of analysis show that CORS station data includes the Carrier Phase and Code Observable (pseudo range) from the code receiver to the satellite, as well as the navigation data and meteorological data, So it has focused on storage system design, and this storage system has significant advantages on the aspects of performance, reliability, expansibility, functionality and information sharing. At last, it has pointed out the future development direction of CORS data storage after combining with the latest storage technology.

articleTitle: Changing entries in soft sets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper is concerned with the normal parameter reduction of soft sets. The problems of changing entries are presented. Then, we introduce the definition of positive and negative changed rates, and these properties are proposed. Furthermore, the normal parameter reduction is investigated after changing entries in soft set.

articleTitle: Semiautomatic transformation system with logic level of Process Blueprint and supported environment design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Auto Design Software has been a hot issue in the software field. In this paper, we propose one automatic transformation method connecting with strict language and semantic function based on the theory of Model-Driven Procedure Blueprint Programming. Through building the formal semantic template of node types and node content descriptions, it makes a good translation from the logic tier of Chinese description to the implementation layer of Programming language. The experiment proved this method effectively enhances the automaticity of the Model-Driven technology.

articleTitle: Study on China's private express companies' strategic innovation based on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: TRIZ is a theory system applied to solve innovation problems. In the paper, it is employed in express industry. Based on the status of China's private express companies, the deficiencies existing in them are summarized into four aspects. With the employment of conflict matrix and innovation principles of TRIZ theory, the conflicts in these deficiencies are deeply analyzed. Besides, the material-field analysis model theory of TRIZ theory is employed to analyze the interaction among national express companies, international express giants and private express companies. Then the solutions to these deficiencies are found out according to the TRIZ theory. At last, a range of strategic innovation ideas are presented for the private express companies.

articleTitle: Research on the rapid design and rapid quotation system of the forging machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to solve such problems as the long cycle of design and manufacture, and difficulties and inaccuracies in price quotation of forging machine tools, this paper carries out a research on the rapid design and quotation system of forging machines. Rapid design transforms the parameters of the user's performance requirements into the design parameters of machine tools, and instantly works out the product design through calculation. Next, it produces the three dimensional model of the product and evaluates the manufacturability of the components. Based on the model obtained from rapid design, rapid quotation is realized by applying the seamless connection technology between the CAPP system and the CAD system into the rapid quotation system, so that it can figure out the costs of the forging machine instantly. The soft-wares developed could greatly enhance the quality and proficiency of forging machine design, and provide important basis and help for the prompt and accurate decision-making of the enterprise.

articleTitle: A selection method of module assembly scheme
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Module assembly is one of key technologies in modular design. A selection method of module assembly scheme, which based on product customization degree (CD) and customer satisfaction degree (SD), was presented in this paper. Product CD, which was the total customization cost and its proportion to whole product cost, was counted, moreover, the customization cost was divided into customization part cost and customization assembly cost, respectively. Some customer satisfaction factors were discussed. The customer SD was gained via separately counting the price and delivery time factors from the other factors. Finally, an example was presented to show the feasibility of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Pseudo-random Code PPM Fuze's Channel Leak and its jamming mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Analyzing an echo signal in time-domain and frequency-domain got a Pseudo-random Code PPM Fuze's channel leak, because of the nonlinear receiver in the fuze, which was the theoretical basis of jamming waveform. Numerical simulation verified correctness of jamming mechanism. A conclusion was the fuze could be jammed through channel leak.

articleTitle: Analysis model of lane adjust about Urban Elevated Road ramp merge area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Urban Elevated Road ramp merge area is usually become a bottleneck of capacity, affecting the use of whole roads resources. Through the traffic characteristics and road structure analysis of merge area, and then adjust the vehicle lane, you can effectively improve the traffic capacity of merge area. Base on elevated road survey data of shanghai, from the relationship analysis between lane width and speed and capacity to proceed, fitting the data using mathematical software to obtain the outer lane headway distribution, and based on gap - accepted theoretical calculation of the ramp capacity, establishing the urban elevated road ramp merge area analysis model about lane adjust, the example analysis of Shanghai proved the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: SIP-based multimedia conference system design and implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: through the in-depth research of current multimedia conference system, this paper proposes a SIP-based multimedia conference system model for NGN network. This system mainly uses SIP application server to achieve conference call control, media server to achieve the mixed distribution of meeting member media streams, and the Web server is to provide the interaction interface between end-user and conference platform, to achieve the relative independence between the conference control and user interaction. Therefore, the system has high reliability, easy to expand.

articleTitle: Optimization for water enviroment fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model based on information entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: According to the water environment assessment characteristics, the fuzzy comprehensive model was optimized. First, the exponential membership function was put forward. The problem was solved that the result was warped because the affect of this indicator was neglected when the membership function of non-neighboring grade is zero. Second, when the overstandard ratio of some indicator is huge, the indicator was excessively relied on during the evaluation. The introduction of the information entropy has revised the weight coefficient with the overstandard ratio. The result in the test showed the evaluation result is more reasonable.

articleTitle: PSWAN : A probabilistic-priority-based QoS model in MANET
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the growing needs of transmitting multimedia traffic in mobile Ad hoc networks (MANET), how to provide quality of service (QoS) guarantees in MANET becomes a hotspot. This paper introduces SWAN—a simple but available QoS model for MANET. After analyzing its principle, working background and drawbacks, a probabilistic-priority-based PSWAN model is proposed in this paper. By combining the probabilistic priority scheduling algorithm with SWAN, PSWAN solves the problem of disability of supporting multi-class differentiated services; and via improving the rate control algorithm, PSWAN performs better in end-to-end delay. Its performance is evaluated via simulations.

articleTitle: Exact traveling wave solution for nonlinear heat conduction equation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we derive exact traveling wave solutions of nonlinear heat conduction equation by a presented method. The method appears to be efficient in seeking exact solutions of no-nlinear equations.

articleTitle: A kind of authentication scheme based Trusted Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents a kind of mutual authentication scheme based on Trusted Computing Platform and smart card for enhancing the security of the system. It accomplishes mutual authentication safely between user and remote trusted server with low computation quantity and less communication, meanwhile, it can resist replay attack and forgery attack effectively. Finally, the article finishes security analysis and computation complexity for the scheme.

articleTitle: Design of flux-weakening control system of PMSM based on fuzzy theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A Fuzzy Controller for the compensation of the Direct-axis current component in the flux-weakening control system of the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) is proposed in this paper. The output torque of PMSM falls down when it operates in the high-speed as the reason of its parameters variation. In order to minimize the influences from the armature reaction, the quadrature-axis current reference component and its deviation with the detection value are chose as the inputs of the Fuzzy controller, and output of the Direct-axis compensation value is obtained as the setting value of the current regulator. The proposed control method is implemented in the experimental platform based on TI DSP chip, the experiment results demonstrate that the Fuzzy control rules and parameters adopted in this paper can improve the performance of torque effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of aerocyst cell inflation deformation based on finite element method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Inflatable structures shape accuracy and stability are a key factor of the wing structural design. The article introduced the application of finite element analysis in inflatable structure form-finding,analyzed the influence of the inflatable aerocyst cellular construction parameters to the inflation deformation,has attributed its relative relations with curves and the function,and further studied the relations between the construction weight and inflation deformation with the parameters variation.

articleTitle: Implement and design on the embedded sleep monitoring system based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The pulse sensor was used for acquiring the signal of pulse in the system, and then the embedded sleep monitor system was designed. The nightmare of volunteers was interrupted by the sound signal with different strength. In order to cut down the possibility of heart and brain diseases caused by nightmare, The data of volunteers' nightmare was collected and analyzed so that we established corresponding strategy and the simulating model of fuzzy control after careful analysis for monitoring sleep quality. The simulating experiments show that the control strategy of this system could perform satisfactorily. The sleeping quality of volunteers had been improved.

articleTitle: Study on model and algorithm for urban rail transit crew scheduling system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Crew scheduling is an important part of operation and management of urban rail transit (URT) and is directly related to its cost. With the growth of urban rail transit line in length and increased crew rotation points, crew scheduling is increasingly complicated. A reasonable crew schedule is necessary for improving the economic benefits of URT. This paper takes the number of drivers as the key measure of cost, and treats crew scheduling as one-dimension packing problem. The solution steps are also designed according to best fit algorithm in this paper. Finally, a computer system for crew scheduling is developed. Take one urban rail transit line for example and the results show that this model and algorithm can figure out reasonable crew schedules.

articleTitle: Metrics selection for fault-proneness prediction of software modules
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: It would be valuable to use metrics to identify the fault-proneness of software modules. It is important to select the most appropriate particular metric subset for fault-proneness prediction. We proposed an approach of metrics selection, which firstly utilized the correlation analysis to eliminate the high the correlation metrics and then ranked the remaining metrics based on the gray relational analysis. Three classifiers, that were logistic regression model, NaiveBayes, and J48, were utilized to empirically investigate the usefulness of selected metrics. Our results, based on a public domain NASA data set, indicate that 1) proposed method for metrics selection is effective, and 2) using 3–4 metrics gets the balanced performance for fault-proneness prediction of software modules.

articleTitle: Sand casting precision technology based on non-occupying coating technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The current status of foundry technology is introduced. A suggestion of improving sand casting precision to realize precision casting by using rapid prototyping technology and non-occupying coating technology is put forward. Combining with making brake drum of sand casting mold, the key technology is analyzed. The advantages are pointed out by comparing with the common.

articleTitle: Conversion design of electro-hydraulic remote control system based on wheel engineering vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The paper is about developing one type of the wheel engineering vehicle from manual control to remote control. It systematically analyzed the operating schematic of the hydraulic system which belongs to one type of the wheel engineering vehicle and the characterization of the manual control, as shown in Fig.1 and Fig.2. Overall plan of the electro-hydraulic remote proportional control system was introduced in Fig.3. The hydraulic oil circuit of controlling part has been established, as shown in Fig.4 and Fig.5. The conversed wheel vehicle is shown in figure 8. The new vehicle can meet the requirement of practical application.

articleTitle: Systematic innovation of B2C E-Commerce model based on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In terms of the current B2C E-Commerce model, deficiency of credit, vacancy of after service and high cost of distribution are becoming bottleneck problems that hinder further development of B2C E-Commerce. In this paper, TRIZ theory is employed to analyze and improve the B2C E-Commerce model. According to this theory, the disequilibrium evolution among sub-systems leads to conflicts in a B2C E-Commerce system and causes the problems of credit, after service and distribution. The problems emerged are analyzed by laws of technical system evolution firstly. Then conflict matrix is applied to remove technical contradictions between sub-systems to resolve the problems. Finally, the systematic innovation thought of B2C E-Commerce model is advanced.

articleTitle: Study on the evaluation of tourist satisfaction in tourism destination based on variable precision rough set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper proposes a tourism destination tourist satisfaction evaluation model on the basis of importance by applying variable precision rough set theory. The model has a very good ability to adapt to the noise data. When processing the data, it doesn't need the supply of prior information outside the data; but, just based on the importance of the various attributes, it can determine the weights of attributes, and then can calculate the tourist satisfaction index. The research shows that the method has greatly improved the accuracy of the weights set of satisfaction, and made up for the defects of large subjectivity because of the need of the prior knowledge in the existing methods. It provides a good idea and effective method for the evaluation of tourist satisfaction in tourism destination.

articleTitle: Rotor unsteady aerodynamics research of a small-scale coaxial helicopter in hovering state
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Based on the engineering reality, a calculation model of the rotor unsteady aerodynamics of a small coaxial helicopter in hovering state had been set up. An airfoil unsteady aerodynamic model was established by introducing a set of Leishman-Beddoes semi-empirical indicial response formulas; the aerodynamic interaction between upper and lower rotors of the coaxial helicopter was set up by bringing an interferential factor in the dynamic inflow model, and the Runge-Kutta method was used to obtain the numerical solution of the rigid flapping angle. According to the calculation and analysis, the thrust and torque responses to a rapid collective pitch increase in hovering state were obtained, and the direction response's differences between the semi-differential and full-differential direction control modes were compared.

articleTitle: Radar resource management in multifunction radar
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, a multifunction radar system architecture has been introduced. Multifunction radar is a phased array radar system. A phased array radar system can adapt its parameters on a near-instantaneous basis according to the way in which it perceives its operating environments. This allows the combination of function such as tracking, surveillance, and weapon guidance, which were traditionally performed by dedicated individual radars. Multifunction radar has clear advantages of being able to instaneously and adaptively position and control the beam, but it also brings a new set of challenges. Radar resource management is the problem of how to allocate finite available resources in an optimal way to carry out a chosen mission.

articleTitle: Metadata matching based on Bayesian network in DataSpace
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The concept of Dataspace was proposed as a new data management paradigm to help unify the diverse efforts on flexible schema, data cleaning, and data integration being pursued by the database community. The heart of Dataspace is “pay-as-you-go” philosophy, which provides Best-Efforts service and brings more convenience to data management. To elevate the service quality, extracting the matching between metadata becomes a crucial problem, while the uncertainty of Dataspace hinders the metadata matching. This paper introduces the Bayesian network model to extract metadata matching, solves the problem of uncertainty by probability reasoning, and can complete the missing metadata as well. The method well suits the circumstance of restrict model nodes and well structured consequence of node.

articleTitle: Accelerating feature extraction for patch-based Multi-View Stereo algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel parallel implementation of HARRIS and DOG detector on GPU for feature extractions of Patch-based Multi-View Stereo (PMVS) algorithm in image sequence. With the Compute Unified Device Architecture(CUDA)-enabled GPU, the acceleration is significant and it obtains a 34 times performance boost comparing to a CPU implementation. We adopt the hardware built-in bilinear interpolation of texture to shorten the time for image resampling while doing image transformations. While lots of time can be saved by using our improved PMVS Algorithm with GPU-based feature extraction, experimental results also show that our implementation can obtain fine details for building accurate object and scene models.

articleTitle: Model and control of Micro Flapping-wing Aerial Robot
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The flying mechanism of birds and big insects, especially the rules of wings motion in flight, are investigated. Some details of mechanical frame are also considered. The entire dynamic model of flight attitude for Micro Flapping-wing Aerial Robot(MFAR) is developed. The design of attitude controller is challenging due to the complexity of the flight process, and the heavy difficulties are system uncertainty, nonlinearity, multi-variable coupled parameters, and all kinds of disturbances. To these difficulties, the system is decomposed into nominal model and uncertain item. An adaptive sliding mode controller is constructed, which not only has a good robustness for the uncertainty but also overcomes the quivering in the control input of conventional sliding mode control. Simulation results are presented to verify the validity of the dynamic model and the control strategy.

articleTitle: Research & evaluation on TPL enterprises based on the Internet Of Things
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The Internet of Things is integration development of some emerging areas such as modern logistics and Internet etc, which will greatly enhances logistics basic facility and logistics technology. Third Party Logistics is the advanced form of modern logistics for socialization and specialization. For the majority of third-party logistics enterprises, it will contribute to the continuous improvement of its competitiveness with the rise of The Internet of Things, to improve the logistics technology and to provide more value-added logistics services. The evaluation optical selection of third-party logistics enterprises increasingly becomes the key points of the recycling economy and green environmental protection industry. Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), a commonly used quantitative research method, is the widely used evaluation indicator solution. This paper presents that the Internet of things enhances the competitiveness of third-party logistics companies with AHP to evaluate it, focusing on technological innovation factors affecting the business in particular, to further optimize system evaluation of third-party logistics enterprise.

articleTitle: A mathematic morphology approach for radial lens correction of document image
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Document image captured by hand-held camera suffers from lens distortion with different degrees, and a mathematic morphology based lens correction algorithm is proposed with the text line of document images. First, it uses Niblack adaptive thresholding algorithm to segment the document images, and clusters connected components into text lines with morphology closing algorithm. Then, it uses second order polynomial to fit the central line of text line, and construct the object function of lens distortion. It warps the curved text line to the straight text line, thus, to solve the distortion parameters of document image. Experiments show this method can effectively correct lens distortion of document image with various degrees.

articleTitle: Based on simulated annealing algorithm Wang-Tile texture synthesis optimization technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, simulated annealing algorithm and wavelet transform is used to improve the Wang-Tile texture synthesis algorithm from the aspects of efficiency and effectiveness. First, the choice of samples generated Tile set can be optimized by using the global optimum trend of simulated annealing algorithm to get the global optimal solution, that is, you can get the best collection of synthetic effects Tile which solves the diamond seam problem in Wang-Tile algorithm. Results were proved to be good experiments. Secondly, in order to improve the efficiency of the algorithm, the two-dimensional wavelet decomposition of the initial samples is carried out before the choice of the sample set. The texture compression can be achieved by searching the best match block after the decomposition, and the sample image is only one forth size compared to the initial image. Therefore, the search time of choosing match block can significantly be reduced, and the efficiency of the algorithm can also be enhanced.

articleTitle: Joint design of signal detection, demodulation classification, channel estimation and automatic gain control for multi speed HART
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Traditionally, signal detection, demodulation classification, channel estimation and automatic gain control are designed separately and stabilization of those functions takes lots of symbols. In this paper, we propose a joint design of all those functions for multi-speed HART, which can adaptively demodulate HART FSK and HART C8PSK signals. According to the characteristics of HART channel and HART preamble, we employ sliding windowed DFT to estimate the power spectrum of HART preamble signal. Spectrum leakage and barrier effect, which are side effects of widowed DFT, are employed. In order to estimate the power at certain frequency lines fast and alleviate the interference of noise, we employ variable coefficient low pass filer. Simulations have shown that joint design of those functions can converge fast and work very well in low SNR.

articleTitle: The objective auscultation research on Traditional Chinese Medical using two novel parameters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study the objective auscultation of Traditional Chinese Medicine utilizing the wavelet analysis theory and two novel parameters. Digital auscultation information, which are the voice samples in this paper were analyzed using wavelet analysis. Two parameters including the energy ratio and max power ratio were proposed as the feature parameters. The used voice samples including: qi-deficiency, yin-deficiency, and health subjects are decomposed into ten layers of wavelet decomposition coefficients. Based on these coefficients, the parameters corresponding to the ranges of the frequency were obtained for every sample. Then the parameters with significant differences among different kinds of signals were studied in order to find the feature information contained in the three kinds of auscultation signals.

articleTitle: Kinetic and thermodynamic aspects of adsorption of arsenic by granular Fe-based adsorbent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: One novel adsorption materials, Mn-loaded iron ore sinter (Mn-IOS), has been conducted to remove arsenate (As (V)) and arsenite (As (III)). The conversion of As (III) to As (V) caused by manganese ion in adsorption progress would be beneficial to adsorption, and therefore, Mn-IOS had a better removal performance of As (III). Results of orthogonal tests suggested that temperature was an important factor, and higher temperature markedly favored the adsorption. The adsorption kinetic data can be well described by pseudo-second-order rate equation with R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> >0.999. The adsorption isotherms fitted well with the Langmuir model. No significant effects on As (III) removal were found by the tested anions, chloride, or sulfate, but phosphate really caused the greatest percentage decrease of As (III) adsorption.

articleTitle: A hierarchical differential evolution algorithm with multiple sub-population parallel search mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Differential evolution (DE) algorithm is a simple yet powerful population-based stochastic search technique for solving optimization problems in the continuous search domain. However, the performance of the canonical DE algorithm crucially depends on appropriately choosing mutation strategies and their associated parameter settings. Unsuitable choice of trial vector generation manners and control parameter values may deteriorate the search process. In this paper, a new version of the differential evolution algorithm is reported, in which both diverse mutation operators and mutation rates are heuristically assigned to various individuals. During the iteration process, the whole populations are classified into subgroups by sufficiently analyzed the individuals' state. Multiple population parallel search policy can effectively expedite the convergence of the proposed algorithm. Diverse mutation operators with distinct characters are assigned to relative subgroups, which are considered to be a better balance between exploration and exploitation. The empirical values and negative feedback technique are used in parameters selection, which relieve the burden of specifying the parameters values. The experimental study of the new approach is test on a set of standard benchmark functions and compares with traditional differential evolution which has a better performance.

articleTitle: Application of regression analysis based on genetic particle swarm algorithm in financial analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Slow convergence speed and premature are two key problems existing in the regression analysis techniques based on genetic algorithm. To overcome the shortcomings,this paper proposes an improved regression analysis based on the genetic particle swarm algorithm. The basic principle is that a new operator is constructed to use PSO. This algorithm has the choice of genetic algorithms and genetic features, and drawing on the searching capabilities of particle towards the optimal forward. Finance analysis evaluates the efficiency of the algorithm. The experimental results show,the improved regression analysis is steady and greatly improve the convergent speed.

articleTitle: A polynomial time algorithm for Hamilton Cycle and its proof
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: We present a polynomial time algorithm for finding a Hamilton Cycle(Path) in an undirected graph and proves its correctness. A program is developed according to this algorithm and it works very well. This paper declares the algorithm, its proof, and the experiment data. Even only our experiment data is a breakthrough.

articleTitle: Quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm with inverse-proportional inertia weight
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In order to improve the performance of particle swarm optimization algorithm and avoid trapping to local excellent situations, this paper presents a new quantum behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm with inverse proportional inertia weight. By the inverse proportional inertia weight function, with the number of iterations increasing, the value of inertia weight function decreasing, the algorithm can keep the searching capability in the early iteration and make the convergence accelerate in later iteration. Testing experiments show this new algorithm's merits not only having the global optimization performance but also raising capability for convergence speed and better quality solutions.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the importance of incentive factors to life insurance agents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Many incentive schemes are adopted by the life-insurance company to encourage life insurance sales staffs to stimulate their potential, to improve performance and in order to improve the core competitiveness of the life-insurance company. The importance of all elements in incentive schemes has become the research core in this article. The pattern of questionnaire is adopted in the research to collect the firsthand information, which is designed according to the status quo of life insurance sales staffs and the basic incentive schemes usually used in life-insurance company and adopts Likert Five-point scoring method. Statistical analysis of data is done by applying SPSS12.0 statistical software, factor analysis done special to the importance of all incentive factors in questionnaire, accordingly the suggestions of optimizing the incentive schemes of life insurance agents.

articleTitle: Laminar cooling model of hot rolled based on Taylor formula
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Laminar cooling is one important part of control cooling in hot rolling mill, and coiling temperature is one important parameter of performance of hot strip. Aim of laminar cooling is to make hot rolled strip from high finishing roll temperature to requested coiling temperature. The linear analytical model is kernel in the general laminar cooling control. It presents laminar cooling system and its original mathematic model of someone rolling mill. A one-time analytical laminar cooling control model is built based on the Taylor formula on consideration of its accuracy shortcomings, and its feed-backward and self-learning model are brought forward too. The offline simulation results show this model meeting field requirements.

articleTitle: A novel mutli-cores MCU architecture based on data flow computing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The concept of data flow computing is increasingly being used to the multi-core and parallel computing architecture in nowadays. This paper presents a new multi-cores MCU architecture, named DFF (Data Flow driven on Function-level), which possesses the characteristics of function-level parallelism and data driven. It efficiently synthesizes the middle grain parallelism of data flow computing and the sequential computing commonly used in von Neumann structure. The main process of the design is explained by an example of data-driven computation implementing where the custom function stored in the single core (NIOSII), in the initialization phase, will begin to run only when all its operands are available, and the system will be in the sleep state when no effective data can be used to drive and the power will be saved significantly. Moreover, the multi-cores can carry out parallel operation under the data-independent. Some feasible verifications of multi-cores MCU architecture are implemented in Altera EP20K200EFC484-2 to prove the validity of this approach. It is shown that the novel architecture with DFF mode can reduces the hardware overhead and the power consumption.

articleTitle: Research and design of video attendance checking system based non-contact IC card
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, a long-distance non-contact IC card and computer video technologies are adopted to design a set of management system for monitoring staff attendance. The system hardware components and software implementations are discussed in details. This system provides a number of advantages, such as non-contact to read, anti-swipe fake card, easy to operate, high reliability and efficiency and so on.

articleTitle: Anti-midlines with inner method enhance positioning accuracy in navigation by three celestial-bodies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The paper based on spherical triangle theory and double celestial-bodies positioning principle, in the model of various astronomical positioning calculate formula, makes analysis for algorithm and its error aim to traditional using of celestial observations height calculating ship's positioning. Put forward an astronomical positioning solution of the Anti-midline method combined with inner method to achieve three celestial-bodies positioning. Since the preparation of computer programs and databases with a horoscope, it not only saves time to get rid of the steps of cumbersome look-up table, computing and mapping, but also improves the positioning accuracy theoretically, so that driving ship drivers from the cumbersome out of balance, there is more time and effort taken to ensure the safety of navigation.

articleTitle: The application of design pattern on intellectualized selecting the doors and windows pattern system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The paper introduces the basic principle of the MVC design pattern, and how to apply to the intellectualized selecting the doors and windows pattern system, which improves the system scalability, maintainability and code reuse rate. At the same time, the paper introduces the realization of the intelligent system, and gives a flexible method of deploying the doors and windows pattern system.

Author Keywords: selecting the doors and windows pattern

articleTitle: Bandwidth allocation in virtual network based on traffic prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: For future Internet, network virtualization provides the feasibility of running multiple routing architectures on a shared physical infrastructure. This paper presents the design and evaluation of a bandwidth allocation algorithm based on multi-commodity flow problem solver, which integrated with a traffic predictor. The basic idea of our design is that some failure in the MFP computation implies that one or more links do not have enough available capacity, which violates the linear constraints on the commodities for each link when modeling MFP. To avoid producing bottleneck links, we employed traffic predictor. On one hand, MFP solver makes better resource utilization by making use of the thin pieces of available bandwidth, by which the virtual network can accept more service requests. On the other hand, the traffic predictor adjusts the link with the largest occupation (bottleneck link) by checking the traffic rate of a user link and adjusting the reserved bandwidth based on the Forecasting of the traffic history. Then we present the results of performance comparisons of the predictor-integrated algorithm and the allocation algorithm only by Solving MFP. The comparisons are based on the mean packet delay, the variance of the packet delay, and the buffer requirements. Our performance tests show that predictor-integrated algorithm works better than the allocation algorithm only by Solving MFP in terms of the three metrics listed above.

articleTitle: Research on PIM-SM multicast routing improvement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: PIM-SM multicast routing opposed to unicast technology has great advantages in multicast applications, but this routing technology has some flaws in the specific network topology. This article talks about the improvement for PIM-SM which is in the exceptional circumstances. For example, if SPT overlaps some or all of RPT, the DR of the source host will send the redundant data packets and the end-to-end delay among group members will be relatively large. Compared with before, the performance of improved PIM-SM doesn't reduce but also overcome these shortcomings.

articleTitle: Eyelid location using Asymmetry Canny Operator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: According to the physiological structure of human eye, the low-pass filter is used to do convolution with the iris image, which is to reduce the interference of the high-frequency information, such as eyelid. And then, Asymmetry Canny Operator is used to do horizontal and vertical edge diction, which is to reduce the interference of eyelash, and strengthen the edge of eyelid. The initial eyelid location was finished by curve fitting to the eyelid that obtained through edge diction. Finally, in the light of individual differences of the eyelid edge, which has the character of single-layer and double-layer, so it constructs parabola edge operator and executes the second search for real eyelid edge on the basis of the acquired eyelid edge in the first detection. The experiment shows that the idea of the algorithm is concise and universal, and the location accurate rate is high. So it is a novel and effective eyelid location algorithm.

articleTitle: Method of plant texture image recognition based on genetic programming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The genetic programming classifier's evolution and the classified speed is quick, the real-time performance is good, the classified recognition needs the domain knowledge to be very few, it is advantageous for the promoted use. This article carries on the imagery processing to the gathering plant bark image. It uses the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix technique description image the texture feature and carries on the recognition and classification using the genetic programming algorithm to the plant image. Through it carries on the classified experiment to many kinds of plant bark image, it indicats that this method is feasible, has the good classified precision.

articleTitle: The evaluation of China's insurance e-commerce website running based on entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the popularization and development of Internet, e-commerce as a new business means takes attention by traditional industry. The insurance industry as a financial traditional industries are trying to make e-commerce insurance migrate to company's internal management, marketing and service areas, in order to adapt to technological advances and market changes. The system entropy is about the complexity of the system, the relations of orderly structure and the description of efficiency state. This article builds mathematical model to evaluate the status of China's e-commerce website running by entropy theory, and finds that China's e-commerce website running in a state of entropy reduction. Finally, the article puts forward the specific policy recommendations according to empirical results.

articleTitle: Quality of learning analysis based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The level of quality of learning is directly related to the competitiveness of students in the future social life, the overall quality and comprehensive national strength of Chinese citizens; the establishment and improvement of student learning quality analysis and guiding systems are the strategic starting point for promotion of education. The Bayesian Network (BN) proposed by Pearl is a new mechanism for uncertain knowledge representation and manipulation based on probability theory and graph theory. BN is network structure with clarity semantics. It exploits the structure of the domain to allow a compact representation of complex joint probability distribution. Its sound probabilistic semantics explicit encoding of relevance relationships, inference algorithms and learning algorithms that are fairly efficient and effective in practice, and decision-making mechanism of facility, have led BN to enter the Artificial Intelligence(AI) mainstream. The present thesis is to make an experimental analysis of the test paper based on Bayesian Network. The main toolkit used in this experiment is BNT software suite compiled with MATLAB. This software suite provides us with a lot of basic function sets for Bayes Network learning. It is suitable for the accurate and appropriate logics of various types of joints, and it also has the function of parameter learning and structure learning. From the experiment we come to the conclusion that five factors including “absorption rate of teaching” and “work accuracy” have great influence on quality of learning.

articleTitle: Particle swarm optimization to solving economic load dispatch with spinning reserve
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A revised strategy particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to solve the economic dispatch problems in power systems. Many constraints such as ramp rate limits and prohibited zones are taken into account, and the loss is also calculated. On the basis of strategy particle swarm optimization algorithm, a new revised strategy is provided to handle the constraints and make sure the particles to satisfy the constraints. The strategy can guarantee the particles to search in or around the feasible solutions area combined with penalty functions. The various load demand and various reserve demand by payment for reserve allocated is also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: A deterministic finite automata based on improved BM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: By analyzing the BM algorithm and DFA theory, a kind of DFA based on improved BM algorithm has been designed in this paper. The DFA based on improved BM algorithm match the pattern string with the text string following the rules: compare from the pattern at both ends of string to the middle alternately. It shows that the characters matching to the patterns exist in the text strings when the DFA based on improved BM algorithm output true,the characters matching to the patterns do not exist in the text strings when it output false. This paper analyzes the effectiveness of the DFA based on improved BM algorithm through simulation and comparative experiments. The experimental data show that the DFA based on improved BM algorithm can improve the efficiency of the pattern matching.

articleTitle: Computer simulation on the performance of a combined-type vertical axis wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The starting performance is one of the problems which greatly affects the development of the straight-bladed vertical axis wind turbine (SB-VAWT). A combined type straight-bladed vertical axis wind turbine (CT-SBVAWT) was designed in this study by setting a Savonius rotor having good starting performance into the SB-VAWT to solve this problem. Computer simulations based on the 2 dimensions incompressible steady flow were carried out both on the model of CT-SBVAWT and SB-VAWT for comparison. The simulation included the static torque coefficients at different azimuth angles and the dynamic torque coefficients at different tip speed ratios. The flow fields around the two type wind turbines were also obtained at some tip speed ratio. Based on the computation results, the effects of the existence of Savonius rotor on the starting and dynamic performance of the CT-SBVAWT were discussed.

articleTitle: A new Call Admission Control algorithm for IEEE802.16 networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, we present a new Call Admission Control (CAC) for IEEE 802.16 broadband wireless networks considering Quality of Service (QoS) constraint. With the assumption that there is a scheduling algorithm to allocate total bandwidths, our proposed CAC algorithm accepts new request for some slot times temporary. In this algorithm, during certain time slots, departure rate for ongoing connections will be decreased and for new connection will increase. After this period, if QoS for ongoing connections and new request is satisfied, new request will be accepted permanently and otherwise it will be rejected. We study the results in two phases, first we show that our algorithm works well with some routine scheduling algorithms and second we show the performance of our algorithm in comparison to some other CAC algorithms. We simulate our algorithm with Matlab tools, and the results show proposed algorithm is quite efficient.

articleTitle: Piecewise fuzzy Lyapunov function based optimal guaranteed cost control law design way
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper investigates the stability analysis and the design of optimal guaranteed cost control law for a class of Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy systems. Based on the structure information of the premise rule base, a novel Lyapunov function called piecewise fuzzy Lyapunov function (PFLF) approach is developed by combining the fuzzy Lyapunov function (FLF) approach with the piecewise quadratic Lyapunov function (PQLF) approach. A new parallel distributed compensation (PDC) controller is also presented. Via the PFLF approach presented, the stability analysis and the design way of optimal guaranteed cost control law are derived in the form of linear inequality matrix (LMI). The designed method in this paper inherits the advantage of FLF and PQLF and ensures the resulting system is asymptotically stable while an upper bound of the closed-loop cost function is minimized. Two numerical examples are supplied to demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed control law.

articleTitle: Study of query of distributed database based on relation semi join
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Query processing and optimization of distributed database are the key factors to affect the performance,service efficiency and reliability of system. On the basis of the study of some common optimization algorithm of distributed query, query optimization algorithm based on multi-relation semi join is put forward to apply to this situation that takes buffer zone of distributed database system as the final assembly station of intermediate result of query. The experiment proves that query optimization algorithm based on multi-relation semi join obviously reduces the data volume of intermediate result and effectively decreases the overall cost of network communications. Comparing with common multi-relation semi join algorithm, the optimization benefit of the algorithm in this article is higher.

articleTitle: Research of collision detection algorithm based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper presents a particle swarm optimization based on real-time collision detection algorithm, and combines the PSO and the OBB hierarchy bounding box algorithm. OBB algorithm close simply establishes three-dimensional object bounding box. the collision detection problem in the three-dimensional space change into a two-dimensional space optimization process. PSO algorithm can quickly determine the regional intervention of geometric model, and exclude non-interference in the region. Then, further details of the triangle collision detection, and improves real-time collision detection in the virtual system.

articleTitle: Design of the pronunciation dictionary for an English CAPT system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Computer Assisted Pronunciation Training (CAPT) systems can judge the overall pronunciation quality and point out the pronunciation errors by recognition of the user's utterance to improve the users' oral ability. However, the performance of the current error detection systems can't satisfy the users' expectation. This paper carefully designs the pronunciation dictionary of the speech recognition engine of the CAPT system based on observation of the spectral properties of some phonemes. First, the phonetic symbol /R/ utilized in some modern English dictionaries is replaced by two symbols, /R/ (as in word result) and /ER/ (as in word bear), due to the large spectral deviation in these two cases. Moreover, rather than using a consonant sequence to represent a consonant cluster, we use one symbol to represent the whole for some consonant clusters, according to the phonetic properties of the consonants. Finally, we divide the phoneme /l/ into clear /l/ and dark /l/ according to the distinction in the manner of articulation and the place of articulation. So is /n/. As a result, we get a new pronunciation dictionary which is more suitable for the speech recognition engine of the CAPT system. The HMMs are trained by using the TIMIT database, and evaluated on a database involving 40 Chinese undergraduates. Experimental results illustrate the effectiveness of the new pronunciation dictionary.

articleTitle: Design of remote data acquisition system of passenger flow based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: According to acquisition data of passenger flow relay on artificial and transporting of unreal-time, this paper introduces system of acquisition data of passenger flow base on GPRS by infrared transducer and pressure transducer. Elaborate hardware scheme design of embedded microprocessor in ARM7 core, implement transporting data of passenger flow to data terminal base on GPRS in time and exact, it is provided a reliable basis for real-time scheduling in public transportation.

articleTitle: An improved coverage display algorithm of optimization for CDMA networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Optimizing wireless networks represents a complex task, directly affecting quality, coverage, capacity and cost. In this paper, a new coverage presentation method based on geographic information system is proposed for coverage optimization in CDMA work. The proposed method represents a novel approach in that it focuses on distribution of successful access points around the base station (BS), that can reflect the actual coverage situation vividly. We analyze and render the distribution of the mobile stations (MS), which successfully access the base station in CDMA network in order to figure out coverage boundary. In a live network optimization test, application of this method to a cell with high proportion of soft-switching has shown the effectiveness of proposed approach.

articleTitle: An area concept extraction algorithm based on association rule
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Ontology learning is from a given area document sets automatic or semi-automatic extraction terms to construct a domain ontology. Area concept extraction is one of the most important aspects in building ontology. In this paper, we proposed an improved area concept extraction algorithm. In the algorithm, we firstly employed association rule algorithm to obtain the similarity between the sememes, and then used the similarity between the sememes to find the similarity between area concepts. Finally our paper achieves the whole area concepts extraction process. By analyzing the experimental results shows the effectiveness and correctness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of campus network security system based on intrusion detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications

articleTitle: Impact study on intentional islanding strategies of distribution networks based on distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: It is widely focused on by the global researchers that distributed generation (DG) can enhance reliability of electric power system. This paper presents an impact study on a DG connected to the distribution networks and proposes rooted tree to model DG island separation according to the radial structure. The directed properties of rooted tree are adopted to reduce the solution space from exponential to linear. Depth first search of edge-weight rooted tree is to determine proper splitting points to split the entire interconnected distribution network into islands ensuring generation/load balance and satisfaction of transmission capacity constraints when islanding operation system is unavoidable. The verification of the intentional islanding scheme is proven with simulations on 7-bus and 69 bus test system.

articleTitle: SWMC fast layer-identification algorithm of penetration acceleration signal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The signal achieved by accelerator in the process of the hard-layer penetration is a typical non-stationary random signal with very large peak pulse amplitude, quite short action time and blurry local characteristic. In addition, the high frequency contained in the signal is so abundant that the traditional time-frequency analysis and non-parameter modeling methods are difficult to effectively analyze and process this kind of signal. On the basis of the analyzing the components of the penetration signal, the EEMD algorithm and Hilbert-Huang transform are used to abstract the instantaneous characteristic of the multi-layer penetration acceleration signal, and the characteristic of penetrating layer is achieved in the decomposed IMF. According to the characteristic, a fast SWMC algorithm is studied to real-time identify the layer characteristic for precise burst control. Finally, the accuracy of the algorithm is well verified in the SIMULINK simulation platform.

articleTitle: An improved BP algorithm for classification of architectural ceramic material
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: This paper proposes a new method to classify architectural ceramic materials by using Genetic algorithm and Artificial Neural Network (ANN). And it addressed the training of a classifier for identification of architectural ceramic materials. By means of the global searching trait of genetic algorithm and the best searching trait of BP algorithm, the combination of them is the best way to optimize the interconnection weights. It makes full use of the improved BP algorithm to classify architectural ceramics materials, which makes classification results faster and more accurate.

articleTitle: About the application of new media technology to education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: The most important trend of education is that more and more new media and technology have emerged in and be applied to teaching and learning, such as podcast, blogger and wiki and so on. However, is the new media technology necessary? How can it be applied to teaching in a right manner? Specifically, the application of podcasts is introduced, to provide references for other media technology application to education and better the application.

articleTitle: Improved Yahalom protocol analysis theory based on ideal and honest
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With people become increasingly dependent on computer networks, people on the requirements of security protocols, which has been realized from the initial establishment of effective communication links to provide safe and reliable communications services now. The correctness of security protocols is very important to the Network Security. There are many security flaws and loopholes in the agreement, not because of the agreement resulting from the use of cryptographic algorithms, but caused by its own structure by the agreement. In this paper, the strand space model Yahalom protocol security for a more detailed analysis and algebra for the existence of defects Yahalom protocol proposes an improved scheme. Analysis indicates that the improvement program to meet the corresponding authentication protocol and confidentiality requirements.

articleTitle: L-band EDFA with high saturation output power and low noise figure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In this paper, the steady-state behavior of L-band EDFA with an inline fiber grating laser is studied, and the physical process of signal amplification is simulated and analyzed in details. Good gain characteristics is achieved by incorporating a backward pump and optimizing the configuration of the Single-Stage L-EDFA. the power conversion efficiency is equal to 22%, the gain value is 25 dB, the noise figure is less than 4.6 dB, and the saturated output power is 21.5 dBm. In addition, the gain flatness is less than ± 0.8 dB, and the flatness of noise figure is less than ± 0.1 dB within 35 nm gain bandwidth.

articleTitle: Research on fruit firmness test system based on virtual instrument technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: A fruit firmness detection system was designed based on LabVIEW development environment which detects the displacement of the pendulum with eddy current displacement sensors according to the impact pendulum method and the signals were treated by the JKU-12 data acquisition cards. The whole system debug successfully in WinXP SP2, LabVIEW8.2 trial version of the Chinese environment. It could record the details of the probe penetrating into the fruit. The system was proved stable and reliable, and it provides a good technical method to test and analyze fruit firmness.

articleTitle: Simulation and research on flow of whirl cavity in a vortex pump
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: In case of the vortex pump, the paper simulated numerical value of three dimensional flow field under turbulence incompressible condition, applying Pro/E to sculpt the model, adopting SIMPLEC algorithm, RNG k-ε turbulence model and partitioning non-structure hex grid in the area of flow passage in the pump. The paper obtained distribution of velocity and pressure in whirl cavity of vortex pump, and gave some flow regulation in whirl cavity through analyzing simulate result. The results are useful to perfect theory on design and optimize design to vortex pump. Meanwhile, the results can be regarded as a kind of theoretical information in vortex-pump research.

articleTitle: A preliminary study on variability of desired speeds
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: For the purpose of simulating real-life traffic, the desired speed, as a common parameter of many microscopic traffic simulators, should be modeled reasonably. The traditional practice is that a driver's desired speed is drawn from a predefined distribution or a distribution estimated from the field data collected on the road and kept unchangeable in a long travel. In this paper, a computational model is proposed to describe the variations of desired speeds at high flow. To validate this model, a relevant simulation experiment based on the proposed model has been conducted, and then the simulation data were compared with the field data in terms of volume, mean speed and speed-volume relation. The results show that the simulation data present a relatively good fit to the field data.

articleTitle: Grid Workflow Scheduling based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Grid Workflow Scheduling represented by DAG(Directed Acyclic Graph) is a typical NP-complete problem, and thus a scheduling algorithm of high efficiency is required. So an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve this problem. In the algorithm, chromosomes of poor fitness make secondary preferential hybridization and mutation with the overall best individual. It not only guarantees the population diversity but increases the convergence rate of population. Experiment results based on Gridsim prove it available and better than standard genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis on operation value of wind power resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Through the research of the impact on the value of operation of wind power by investment cost and environmental benefits, we can draw the following conclusions: Based on coal-fired thermal power pollutants emission rate and contaminants based on environmental values, if we want to have 500MW of installed capacity of wind power compared to thermal, The environmental value is 0.09548 yuan·kWh<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, the conclusion plays a guiding role in the rapid development of wind power technology.

articleTitle: The design of USB communication interface system based on TMS320F2812
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Control System needs high data communication with PC, but transfer speed of traditional serial port protocol RS232, RS485 is slow. A communication system is proposed, which uses high speed digital signal processor TMS320F2812 of TI as control and process core, and uses CY7C68001 of CYPRESS as USB2.0 interface chip, and uses FPGA chip XC3S400 of XILINX as assistant control chip. Detailed hardware interface circuit principle graph and software design method, program flow chart of TMS320F2812 are given. Driver program and application program of PC are discussed, and high data communication is implemented.

articleTitle: Study of embedded Linux surveillance system using TCP/IP network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: With the further development of network transmission technology, embedded technology, visual tracking technology, as well as people require to reduce the cost of surveillance system, improve reliability of system, increase the degree of system's intelligence, the intelligent remote video monitoring system is becoming the new hot topic. This paper combines the embedded technology and TCP / IP network technology to achieve remote video surveillance system based on embedded Linux. The collection side hardware of the system uses S3C2440 chip based on ARM core, the operating system uses the embedded Linux, the service program runs by Demon in the operating system to wait monitor connection terminal for providing service to achieve remote monitoring on the LAN or on the Internet and parameter setting, and thus achieve the basic platform of the intelligent control system.

articleTitle: Analysing indirect jump based on critical semantic subtree
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference On Computer Design and Applications
abstract: Indirect jump has been widely adopted in implementing multi-way branches due to its flexibility of jump targets, which makes it difficult to carry out reverse analysis of binary. To deal with this, the traditional approach is to summarize characteristics how compilers generate instructions, using the corresponding pattern to match and process.
